### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminInventory.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Package, AlertTriangle, Search, Filter, Edit3, X, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import SEO from '../../components/SEO';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function AdminInventory() {
  const { token, logout } = useAuth();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  
  // Edit State
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editStock, setEditStock] = useState<number>(0);
  const [editMinStock, setEditMinStock] = useState<number>(0);

  const fetchInventory = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/inventory`, {
        headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      
      if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
        logout();
        return;
      }
      
      const data = await res.json();
      setProducts(data.data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to load inventory.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) fetchInventory();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [token]);

  const handleSave = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/inventory/${id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { 
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` 
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ stock: editStock, minStock: editMinStock })
      });
      
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        toast.success('Inventory updated successfully');
        setEditingId(null);
        fetchInventory();
      } else {
        toast.error(data.message || 'Update failed');
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Network error');
    }
  };

  const startEdit = (p: any) => {
    setEditingId(p._id);
    setEditStock(p.stock || 0);
    setEditMinStock(p.minStock || 0);
  };

  const filteredProducts = products.filter(p => {
    const name = p.name || p.title || '';
    return name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || 
      (p.sku && p.sku.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <SEO title="Inventory | Admin" description="Admin Inventory" />
      
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-2">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">Inventory Management</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 mt-1">Track and adjust product stock levels and alerts.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 mb-6">
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <Search size={18} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-600" />
          <input 
            type="text" 
            placeholder="Search products or SKU..." 
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900"
          />
        </div>
        <button className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium transition-colors">
          <Filter size={18} />
          Filters
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden min-h-[400px]">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-64 text-slate-600">
            <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-primary mb-4"></div>
            Loading inventory...
          </div>
        ) : filteredProducts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-64 text-slate-600">
            <Package size={48} className="mb-4 opacity-20" />
            <p>No products found.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
              <thead className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">Product</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">SKU</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">Status</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">Current Stock</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">Low Stock Alert At</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs text-right">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {filteredProducts.map((p) => {
                  const isEditing = editingId === p._id;
                  const isLowStock = p.stock <= p.minStock && p.stock > 0;
                  const isOutOfStock = p.stock <= 0;
                  
                  return (
                    <tr key={p._id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 overflow-hidden flex-shrink-0">
                            {p.coverImage ? (
                              <img src={p.coverImage} alt={p.name || p.title || 'Product'} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                            ) : (
                              <Package className="w-5 h-5 m-2.5 text-slate-600" />
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <p className="font-bold text-slate-900">{p.name || p.title || 'Untitled'}</p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{typeof p.category === 'object' ? (p.category as any).name : p.category}</p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-600">{p.sku || 'N/A'}</td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        {isOutOfStock ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-red-100 text-red-700">
                            <AlertTriangle size={12} /> Out of Stock
                          </span>
                        ) : isLowStock ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-orange-100 text-orange-700">
                            <AlertTriangle size={12} /> Low Stock
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-green-100 text-green-700">
                            <Check size={12} /> In Stock
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        {isEditing ? (
                          <input 
                            type="number" 
                            min="0"
                            value={editStock} 
                            onChange={e => setEditStock(parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)}
                            className="w-20 border border-slate-300 rounded px-2 py-1 text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <span className="font-mono text-slate-900 font-medium">{p.stock || 0}</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        {isEditing ? (
                          <input 
                            type="number" 
                            min="0"
                            value={editMinStock} 
                            onChange={e => setEditMinStock(parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)}
                            className="w-20 border border-slate-300 rounded px-2 py-1 text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <span className="font-mono text-slate-500">{p.minStock || 0}</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                        {isEditing ? (
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                            <button onClick={() => setEditingId(null)} className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-lg transition-colors">
                              <X size={16} />
                            </button>
                            <button onClick={() => handleSave(p._id)} className="p-1.5 bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-lg transition-colors">
                              <Check size={16} />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <button onClick={() => startEdit(p)} className="p-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 rounded-lg transition-colors">
                            <Edit3 size={16} />
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx
```tsx
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Mail, Lock, ArrowRight, ShieldAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { z } from 'zod';
import Button from '../../components/Button';
import SEO from '../../components/SEO';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useEffect } from 'react';

const loginSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string().email("Please enter a valid email address."),
  password: z.string().min(6, "Password must be at least 6 characters."),
});

type LoginFormValues = z.infer<typeof loginSchema>;

export default function AdminLogin() {
  const { register, handleSubmit, formState: { errors, isSubmitting }, setError } = useForm<LoginFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(loginSchema)
  });
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { login, isAuthenticated, user } = useAuth();

  useEffect(() => {
    // If already logged in and is admin, redirect to admin panel
    if (isAuthenticated && user?.role === 'ADMIN') {
      navigate('/admin');
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated, user, navigate]);

  const onSubmit = async (data: LoginFormValues) => {
    try {
      const normalizedEmail = data.email.trim().toLowerCase();
      const response = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: normalizedEmail, password: data.password }),
      });

      let result;
      let rawText = '';
      try {
        rawText = await response.text();
        result = JSON.parse(rawText);
      } catch (parseError) {
        throw new Error(`Server error`);
      }

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(result.message || 'Failed to login');
      }

      if (result.user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
        throw new Error('Access denied. You do not have admin privileges.');
      }

      login(result.token, {
        id: result.user.id,
        name: result.user.name,
        email: result.user.email,
        role: result.user.role
      });
      navigate('/admin');
    } catch (error: any) {
      setError('root', { message: error.message });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center px-4 bg-slate-900 relative overflow-hidden">
      <SEO title="Admin Login | KDW" description="Secure Admin Access" />
      <div className="absolute top-1/4 -left-1/4 w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-primary/20 rounded-full blur-[100px] -z-10"></div>
      
      <div className="bg-slate-800 p-8 md:p-12 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md border border-slate-700 shadow-2xl relative z-10">
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-primary/10 rounded-2xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
            <ShieldAlert size={32} className="text-primary" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-white mb-2">Admin Portal</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-400">Secure access required</p>
        </div>
        
        {errors.root && (
          <div className="bg-danger/10 border border-danger/20 text-danger px-4 py-3 rounded-xl mb-6 text-sm text-center">
            {errors.root.message}
          </div>
        )}
        
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-5">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 mb-1.5">Admin Email</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                <Mail size={18} className={errors.email ? "text-danger" : "text-slate-500"} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <input 
                id="email"
                type="email" 
                {...register("email")}
                className={`w-full bg-slate-900/50 border ${errors.email ? 'border-danger focus:ring-danger/50' : 'border-slate-700 focus:ring-primary/50'} rounded-xl py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-white placeholder-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-all`}
                placeholder="admin@example.com"
                aria-invalid={errors.email ? "true" : "false"}
              />
            </div>
            {errors.email && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger flex items-center gap-1" role="alert">{errors.email.message}</p>}
          </div>
          
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
              <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">Password</label>
            </div>
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                <Lock size={18} className={errors.password ? "text-danger" : "text-slate-500"} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <input 
                id="password"
                type="password" 
                {...register("password")}
                className={`w-full bg-slate-900/50 border ${errors.password ? 'border-danger focus:ring-danger/50' : 'border-slate-700 focus:ring-primary/50'} rounded-xl py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-white placeholder-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-all`}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                aria-invalid={errors.password ? "true" : "false"}
              />
            </div>
            {errors.password && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger flex items-center gap-1" role="alert">{errors.password.message}</p>}
          </div>
          
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full mt-4" size="lg" isLoading={isSubmitting}>
            Authenticate <ArrowRight size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
          </Button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  FolderOpen, Upload, Search, Link as LinkIcon, Trash2, 
  ExternalLink, FileImage, FileText, FileVideo, HardDrive, Filter 
} from 'lucide-react';
import Button from '../../components/Button';
import axios from 'axios';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

interface DriveFile {
  _id: string;
  filename: string;
  size: string;
  linkedProduct: string;
  status: string;
  driveUrl: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

export default function AdminMediaManager() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<DriveFile[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  
  // Upload Modal State
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newFile, setNewFile] = useState({
    filename: '',
    size: '',
    linkedProduct: 'None',
    driveUrl: ''
  });
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const fetchFiles = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await axios.get('/api/admin/drive', {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      if (res.data.success) {
        setFiles(res.data.data);
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Failed to load media files');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFiles();
  }, []);

  const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this media file link?')) return;
    try {
      const res = await axios.delete(`/api/admin/drive/${id}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      if (res.data.success) {
        toast.success('Media file deleted');
        fetchFiles();
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Failed to delete media file');
    }
  };

  const handleUploadSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newFile.filename || !newFile.driveUrl) {
      return toast.error('Filename and Drive URL are required');
    }
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await axios.post('/api/admin/drive', newFile, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      if (res.data.success) {
        toast.success('Media successfully linked');
        setIsModalOpen(false);
        setNewFile({ filename: '', size: '', linkedProduct: 'None', driveUrl: '' });
        fetchFiles();
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Failed to add media file');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredFiles = files.filter(f => 
    f.filename.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || 
    f.linkedProduct.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const getFileIcon = (filename: string) => {
    const ext = filename.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();
    if (['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp', 'gif', 'svg'].includes(ext || '')) return <FileImage size={40} className="text-blue-500" />;
    if (['mp4', 'mov', 'avi', 'webm'].includes(ext || '')) return <FileVideo size={40} className="text-purple-500" />;
    return <FileText size={40} className="text-slate-500" />;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center h-64"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
            <HardDrive className="text-primary" />
            Media Manager
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Manage external files, images, and Drive links</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)} className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Upload size={18} />
          Link New Media
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Filters and Search */}
      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4 justify-between">
        <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-md">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-600" size={18} />
          <input 
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search by filename or linked product..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-sm"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Filter size={16} /> Filter
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <FolderOpen size={16} /> Folders
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Media Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
        {filteredFiles.length > 0 ? filteredFiles.map(file => (
          <div key={file._id} className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden hover:shadow-md transition-shadow group">
            <div className="h-40 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center relative">
              {getFileIcon(file.filename)}
              <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 flex gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                <a href={file.driveUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="p-1.5 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:text-primary rounded shadow-sm border border-slate-200" title="Open Link">
                  <ExternalLink size={14} />
                </a>
                <button onClick={() => handleDelete(file._id)} className="p-1.5 bg-white text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 rounded shadow-sm border border-slate-200" title="Delete">
                  <Trash2 size={14} />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm truncate" title={file.filename}>{file.filename}</h3>
              <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500 space-y-1">
                <p className="flex justify-between"><span>Size:</span> <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">{file.size}</span></p>
                <p className="flex justify-between"><span>Product:</span> <span className="font-medium text-slate-700 truncate max-w-[100px]">{file.linkedProduct}</span></p>
                <p className="flex justify-between items-center mt-2">
                  <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold ${file.status === 'Synced' ? 'bg-success/10 text-success' : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'}`}>
                    {file.status}
                  </span>
                  <span>{new Date(file.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )) : (
          <div className="col-span-full py-12 text-center bg-white rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300">
            <FolderOpen size={48} className="mx-auto text-slate-700 mb-4" />
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">No media files found</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Upload or link new files to see them here.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Upload/Link Modal */}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-100 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-50">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <LinkIcon size={18} className="text-primary" />
                Link Drive Media
              </h3>
              <button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} className="text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-600">
                <Trash2 size={18} className="hidden" /> {/* Placeholder for alignment */}
                <span className="text-xl leading-none">&times;</span>
              </button>
            </div>
            
            <form onSubmit={handleUploadSubmit} className="p-6 space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">Filename <span className="text-red-500">*</span></label>
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  value={newFile.filename}
                  onChange={e => setNewFile({...newFile, filename: e.target.value})}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                  placeholder="e.g. course-video-1.mp4"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">Google Drive URL <span className="text-red-500">*</span></label>
                <input 
                  type="url" 
                  value={newFile.driveUrl}
                  onChange={e => setNewFile({...newFile, driveUrl: e.target.value})}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                  placeholder="https://drive.google.com/file/d/..."
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">File Size</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    value={newFile.size}
                    onChange={e => setNewFile({...newFile, size: e.target.value})}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                    placeholder="e.g. 2.4 GB"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">Linked Product</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    value={newFile.linkedProduct}
                    onChange={e => setNewFile({...newFile, linkedProduct: e.target.value})}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                    placeholder="Product Name or ID"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div className="pt-4 flex justify-end gap-3 border-t border-slate-100">
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
                <Button type="submit" isLoading={isSubmitting}>Link Media</Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminNotifications.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Bell, Search, Filter, Trash2, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, Info, ShoppingBag, User } from 'lucide-react';
import axios from 'axios';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function AdminNotifications() {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  const fetchNotifications = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await axios.get('/api/admin/notifications', {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      if (res.data.success) {
        setNotifications(res.data.data);
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Failed to fetch notifications');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchNotifications();
  }, []);

  const markAsRead = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const res = await axios.patch(`/api/admin/notifications/${id}/read`, {}, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      if (res.data.success) {
        setNotifications(notifications.map(n => n._id === id ? { ...n, isRead: true } : n));
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Failed to mark as read');
    }
  };

  const deleteNotification = async (id: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this notification?')) return;
    try {
      const res = await axios.delete(`/api/admin/notifications/${id}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      if (res.data.success) {
        setNotifications(notifications.filter(n => n._id !== id));
        toast.success('Notification deleted');
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Failed to delete');
    }
  };

  const filteredNotifications = notifications.filter(n => 
    n.message.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || 
    n.type.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const getIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'Order': return <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"><ShoppingBag size={20} /></div>;
      case 'System': return <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"><Info size={20} /></div>;
      case 'Alert': return <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-red-100 text-red-600 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"><AlertTriangle size={20} /></div>;
      case 'Customer': return <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-purple-100 text-purple-600 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"><User size={20} /></div>;
      default: return <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"><Bell size={20} /></div>;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-12">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Bell className="text-primary" /> Notifications
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 mt-1">System alerts and admin announcements.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Controls */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-t-2xl border-x border-t border-slate-200 p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4">
        <div className="relative w-full sm:max-w-md">
          <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-600" />
          <input 
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search notifications..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <button className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 w-full sm:w-auto justify-center">
            <Filter size={16} /> Filters
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* List */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-b-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden min-h-[400px]">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-64 text-slate-600">
            <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-primary mb-4"></div>
            Loading notifications...
          </div>
        ) : filteredNotifications.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-64 text-slate-600">
            <Bell size={48} className="mb-4 opacity-20" />
            <p>No notifications found.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
            {filteredNotifications.map((n) => (
              <div key={n._id} className={`p-4 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors flex items-start gap-4 ${n.isRead ? 'opacity-70' : 'bg-primary/5 border-l-2 border-l-primary'}`}>
                {getIcon(n.type)}
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                    <div>
                      <p className={`text-sm ${n.isRead ? 'text-slate-700' : 'text-slate-900 font-bold'}`}>{n.message}</p>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
                        <span>{n.type}</span>
                        <span>•</span>
                        <span>{new Date(n.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
                      {!n.isRead && (
                        <button onClick={() => markAsRead(n._id)} className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-50 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Mark as Read">
                          <CheckCircle size={16} />
                        </button>
                      )}
                      <button onClick={() => deleteNotification(n._id)} className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-danger hover:bg-danger/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Delete">
                        <Trash2 size={16} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 text-sm text-slate-500 flex justify-between items-center">
          <span>Showing {filteredNotifications.length} records</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Search, Filter, Download, MoreVertical, FileText, XCircle, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatCurrency } from '../../utils/currency';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';

export default function AdminOrders() {
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [filterTab, setFilterTab] = useState('All Orders');
  const { token, logout } = useAuth();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!token) return;
    const fetchOrders = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const res = await fetch('/api/orders', {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
        });
        if (res.status === 401) {
          logout();
          return;
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          setOrders(data.data);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch orders:", err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchOrders();
  }, [token, logout]);

  const handleStatusChange = async (id: string, status: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to mark this order as ${status}?`)) return;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/orders/${id}/status`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        setOrders(orders.map(o => o._id === id ? { ...o, status } : o));
      } else {
        alert(data.message);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to update order status:", err);
    }
  };

  const handleExportCSV = () => {
    if (orders.length === 0) return;
    const headers = ['Order ID', 'Customer Name', 'Customer Email', 'Date', 'Amount', 'Status', 'Payment Gateway'];
    const rows = orders.map(o => [
      o.orderId,
      o.userId?.name || o.guestEmail || 'Unknown',
      o.userId?.email || o.guestEmail || '',
      new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleDateString(),
      o.amount,
      o.status,
      'Razorpay' // Or extract from order if multiple gateways supported
    ]);
    const csvContent = "data:text/csv;charset=utf-8," 
      + headers.join(',') + '\n' 
      + rows.map(e => e.join(',')).join('\n');
    
    const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", encodedUri);
    link.setAttribute("download", "kwd_orders.csv");
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  const filteredOrders = useMemo(() => {
    return orders.filter(o => {
      // Search matching
      const customerName = o.userId?.name || o.guestEmail || 'Unknown';
      const email = o.userId?.email || o.guestEmail || '';
      
      const matchesSearch = 
        (o.orderId || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        email.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());

      // Tab filtering
      const matchesTab = 
        filterTab === 'All Orders' ? true :
        filterTab === 'Paid' ? (o.status === 'paid' || o.status === 'completed') :
        filterTab === 'Pending' ? o.status === 'pending' : true;

      return matchesSearch && matchesTab;
    });
  }, [orders, searchTerm, filterTab]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-12">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">Orders</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 mt-1">Manage all transactions, refunds, and invoices.</p>
        </div>
        <button onClick={handleExportCSV} className="bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors text-sm flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-center">
          <Download size={18} />
          Export CSV
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Table Controls */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-t-2xl border-x border-t border-slate-200 p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4">
        <div className="relative w-full sm:max-w-xs">
          <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-600" />
          <input 
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search by Order ID or Customer..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full sm:w-auto overflow-x-auto pb-2 sm:pb-0">
          <button 
            onClick={() => setFilterTab('All Orders')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${filterTab === 'All Orders' ? 'bg-primary text-white' : 'border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'}`}
          >
            All Orders
          </button>
          <button 
            onClick={() => setFilterTab('Paid')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${filterTab === 'Paid' ? 'bg-primary text-white' : 'border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'}`}
          >
            Paid
          </button>
          <button 
            onClick={() => setFilterTab('Pending')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${filterTab === 'Pending' ? 'bg-primary text-white' : 'border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'}`}
          >
            Pending
          </button>
          <button className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 whitespace-nowrap">
            <Filter size={16} /> More Filters
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Data Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-b-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
            <thead className="bg-slate-50/50 text-slate-500 font-semibold border-b border-slate-200">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Order Details</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Date</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Customer</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Payment</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Amount</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {loading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={6} className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-slate-500 animate-pulse">
                    Loading orders...
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : filteredOrders.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={6} className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-slate-500">
                    No orders found matching "{searchTerm}".
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredOrders.map((order) => {
                  const customerName = order.userId?.name || order.guestEmail || 'Unknown Customer';
                  const email = order.userId?.email || order.guestEmail || '';
                  const productNames = order.items.map((i: any) => i.name).join(', ');
                  const isPaid = order.status === 'paid' || order.status === 'completed';
                  
                  return (
                    <tr key={order._id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors group">
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <p className="font-bold text-slate-900">{order.orderId}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-[200px] truncate" title={productNames}>{productNames}</p>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-600">
                        {new Date(order.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <p className="font-medium text-slate-900">{customerName}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{email}</p>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 items-start">
                          <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-full capitalize ${
                            isPaid ? 'bg-success/10 text-success' :
                            order.status === 'pending' ? 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600' :
                            order.status === 'refunded' ? 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-600' :
                            'bg-danger/10 text-danger'
                          }`}>
                            {order.status}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-600 font-medium">Razorpay</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                        {formatCurrency(order.amount)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                          <button className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="View Invoice">
                            <FileText size={16} />
                          </button>
                          {isPaid && (
                            <button onClick={() => handleStatusChange(order._id, 'refunded')} className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Issue Refund">
                              <RotateCcw size={16} />
                            </button>
                          )}
                          {(order.status === 'pending' || isPaid) && (
                            <button onClick={() => handleStatusChange(order._id, 'failed')} className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-danger hover:bg-danger/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Cancel Order">
                              <XCircle size={16} />
                            </button>
                          )}
                          <button className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="More Actions">
                            <MoreVertical size={16} />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        
        {/* Pagination */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
          <span>Showing 1 to {filteredOrders.length} of {filteredOrders.length} orders</span>
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            <button className="px-3 py-1 border border-slate-200 rounded hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">Previous</button>
            <button className="px-3 py-1 bg-primary text-white rounded font-medium">1</button>
            <button className="px-3 py-1 border border-slate-200 rounded hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">2</button>
            <button className="px-3 py-1 border border-slate-200 rounded hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">Next</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminPayments.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Search, Filter, Download, ExternalLink, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, MoreVertical } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatCurrency } from '../../utils/currency';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { exportToCSV } from '../../utils/csvExport';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function AdminPayments() {
  const [payments, setPayments] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const { token, logout } = useAuth();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!token) return;
    
    const fetchPayments = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const res = await fetch('/api/orders', {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
        });
        if (res.status === 401) {
          logout();
          return;
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          // Map orders to payment transaction logs
          const mappedPayments = data.data.map((order: any) => {
            
            // Mocking or pulling real transaction ID
            let txnId = order.razorpayPaymentId || order.paymentId;
            if (!txnId) {
                // generate a fake txn id for orders that don't have one (like mock data)
                txnId = order.orderId ? order.orderId.replace('ORD-', 'pay_') : `pay_${order._id.substring(0, 10)}`;
            }

            // Gateway logic
            const gateway = txnId.startsWith('pi_') || txnId.startsWith('txn_') ? 'Stripe' : 'Razorpay';
            
            // Status mapping
            let paymentStatus = 'Pending';
            if (order.status === 'paid' || order.status === 'completed') paymentStatus = 'Successful';
            if (order.status === 'failed') paymentStatus = 'Failed';
            if (order.status === 'refunded') paymentStatus = 'Refunded';

            return {
              id: order._id,
              transactionId: txnId,
              gateway,
              amount: order.amount,
              status: paymentStatus,
              customerName: order.user?.name || 'Guest',
              method: order.paymentMethod || 'Card',
              createdAt: order.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
            };
          });
          setPayments(mappedPayments);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch payments:", err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchPayments();
  }, [token, logout]);

  const filteredPayments = payments.filter(p => 
    p.transactionId.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
    p.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const handleExport = () => {
    const exportData = filteredPayments.map(p => ({
      TransactionID: p.transactionId,
      Customer: p.customerName,
      Amount: formatCurrency(p.amount),
      Method: p.method,
      Status: p.status,
      Date: new Date(p.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()
    }));
    exportToCSV(exportData, 'payments_export');
    toast.success('Payments exported successfully');
  };

  const handleMockAction = (action: string) => {
    toast.success(`${action} feature coming soon!`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-12">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">Payments</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 mt-1">Transaction logs from Razorpay and Stripe.</p>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={handleExport}
          className="bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors text-sm flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-center"
        >
          <Download size={18} />
          Export Data
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Table Controls */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-t-2xl border-x border-t border-slate-200 p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4">
        <div className="relative w-full sm:max-w-xs">
          <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-600" />
          <input 
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search payments..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <button className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 w-full sm:w-auto justify-center">
            <Filter size={16} /> Filters
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Data Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-b-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
            <thead className="bg-slate-50/50 text-slate-500 font-semibold border-b border-slate-200">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Transaction ID</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Gateway</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Amount</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Status</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {loading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={5} className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-slate-500 animate-pulse">
                    Loading transactions...
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : filteredPayments.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={5} className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-slate-500">
                    No transactions found matching "{searchTerm}".
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredPayments.map((payment) => (
                  <tr key={payment.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors group">
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <p className="font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono text-xs">{payment.transactionId}</p>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">{payment.gateway}</span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 font-black text-slate-900">
                      {formatCurrency(payment.amount)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-full border ${
                        payment.status === 'Successful' ? 'bg-success/10 text-success border-success/20' :
                        payment.status === 'Pending' ? 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 border-amber-500/20' :
                        payment.status === 'Refunded' ? 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-600 border-slate-300' :
                        'bg-danger/10 text-danger border-danger/20'
                      }`}>
                        {payment.status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                        <button onClick={() => handleMockAction('View Gateway Details')} className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="View Gateway Details">
                          <ExternalLink size={16} />
                        </button>
                        {payment.status === 'Failed' && (
                          <button onClick={() => handleMockAction('Retry Payment')} className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Retry Payment">
                            <RefreshCw size={16} />
                          </button>
                        )}
                        {payment.status === 'Successful' && (
                          <button onClick={() => handleMockAction('Issue Refund')} className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-danger hover:bg-danger/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Issue Refund">
                            <AlertCircle size={16} />
                          </button>
                        )}
                        <button onClick={() => handleMockAction('More Options')} className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="More Options">
                          <MoreVertical size={16} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        
        {/* Pagination */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
          <span>Showing {filteredPayments.length} records</span>
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            <button className="px-3 py-1 border border-slate-200 rounded hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">Prev</button>
            <button className="px-3 py-1 bg-primary text-white rounded font-medium">1</button>
            <button className="px-3 py-1 border border-slate-200 rounded hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">Next</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminProductForm.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ArrowLeft, Save, UploadCloud, Image as ImageIcon, CheckCircle, Tag, IndianRupee, Layers, FileText, HelpCircle, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import Button from '../../components/Button';
import { useStore } from '../../store/useStore';

export default function AdminProductForm() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { id } = useParams();
  const isEditing = Boolean(id);
  
  const { addProduct, updateProduct, products, categories } = useStore();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('general');
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [slug, setSlug] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('Templates');
  const [tagsInput, setTagsInput] = useState('');
  const [price, setPrice] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [detailedDescription, setDetailedDescription] = useState('');

  const [googleDriveFileId, setGoogleDriveFileId] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('Active');
  const [isFeatured, setIsFeatured] = useState(false);
  const [isBestSeller, setIsBestSeller] = useState(false);
  const [isNewArrival, setIsNewArrival] = useState(false);
  const [downloadLimit, setDownloadLimit] = useState('');
  const [seoTitle, setSeoTitle] = useState('');
  const [seoDescription, setSeoDescription] = useState('');
  const [metaKeywords, setMetaKeywords] = useState('');
  const [refundPolicy, setRefundPolicy] = useState('5-Day Money Back');
  const [supportInfo, setSupportInfo] = useState('');
  
  // New details fields
  const [whatsIncluded, setWhatsIncluded] = useState('');
  const [softwareRequired, setSoftwareRequired] = useState('');
  const [version, setVersion] = useState('');
  const [brand, setBrand] = useState('');
  const [stock, setStock] = useState('0');
  const [sold, setSold] = useState('0');
  const [seller, setSeller] = useState('');
  const [discount, setDiscount] = useState('0');

  const [coverImagePreview, setCoverImagePreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [galleryImages, setGalleryImages] = useState<string[]>(['', '', '']);

  // Load existing product if editing
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isEditing && id) {
      const product = products.find(p => p.id === id);
      if (product) {
        setTitle(product.title || '');
        setSlug(product.slug || '');
        setCategory((typeof product.category === 'object' ? (product.category as any).name : product.category) || 'Templates');
        setTagsInput(product.tags ? product.tags.join(', ') : '');
        setPrice(product.price ? product.price.toString() : '0');
        setDescription(product.description || '');
        setDetailedDescription(product.detailedDescription || '');
        setCoverImagePreview(product.coverImage || null);
        
        const initialGallery = ['', '', ''];
        if (product.images && Array.isArray(product.images)) {
          product.images.forEach((img: string, idx: number) => {
            if (idx < 3) initialGallery[idx] = img;
          });
        }
        setGalleryImages(initialGallery);
        
        // Extended fields if they exist on the product
        setStatus(product.status || 'Active');
        setIsFeatured(product.isFeatured || false);
        setIsBestSeller(product.isBestSeller || false);
        setIsNewArrival(product.isNewArrival || false);

        setGoogleDriveFileId(product.googleDriveFileId || '');
        setDownloadLimit(product.downloadLimit?.toString() || '');
        setSeoTitle(product.seoTitle || '');
        setSeoDescription(product.seoDescription || '');
        setMetaKeywords(product.metaKeywords?.join(', ') || '');
        setRefundPolicy(product.refundPolicy || '5-Day Money Back');
        setSupportInfo(product.supportInfo || '');
        
        setWhatsIncluded(product.whatsIncluded || '');
        setSoftwareRequired(product.softwareRequired || '');
        setVersion(product.version || '');

        setBrand(product.brand || '');
        setStock(product.stock !== undefined ? product.stock.toString() : '0');
        setSold(product.sold !== undefined ? product.sold.toString() : '0');
        setSeller(product.seller || '');
        setDiscount(product.discount !== undefined ? product.discount.toString() : '0');
      } else {
        toast.error("Product not found");
        navigate('/admin/products');
      }
    }
  }, [id, isEditing, products, navigate]);

  const handleCoverImageChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      const file = e.target.files[0];
      setCoverImagePreview(URL.createObjectURL(file));
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!title.trim()) {
      toast.error('Product Name is required.');
      return;
    }
    
    const parsedPrice = parseFloat(price);
    if (isNaN(parsedPrice) || parsedPrice < 0) {
      toast.error('Price must be a valid number greater than or equal to 0.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    
    try {
      const productData = {
        title: title.trim(),
        slug: slug.trim(),
        description: description || 'No description provided.',
        detailedDescription,
        price: parsedPrice,
        category: category,
        tags: tagsInput.split(',').map(t => t.trim()).filter(t => t),
        coverImage: coverImagePreview || '',
        images: galleryImages, // Save all 3 slots, empty strings mean blank slots
        status,
        isFeatured,
        isBestSeller,
        isNewArrival,
        googleDriveFileId,
        downloadLimit: downloadLimit ? parseInt(downloadLimit) : undefined,
        seoTitle,
        seoDescription,
        metaKeywords: metaKeywords.split(',').map(k => k.trim()).filter(k => k),
        refundPolicy,
        supportInfo,
        whatsIncluded,
        softwareRequired,
        version,
        brand,
        stock: parseInt(stock) || 0,
        sold: parseInt(sold) || 0,
        seller,
        discount: parseFloat(discount) || 0
      };

      const token = localStorage.getItem('token');

      if (isEditing && id) {
        // Optimistic update
        updateProduct(id, productData);
        
        try {
          await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`, {
            method: 'PUT',
            headers: { 
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` 
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(productData)
          });
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Backend update failed", err);
        }
        
        toast.success('Product updated successfully!');
      } else {
        let newProductId = 'p' + Date.now();
        
        try {
          const response = await fetch('/api/products', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` 
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              rating: 0,
              reviews: 0,
              license: 'Standard',
              features: [],
              includedFiles: [],
              ...productData
            })
          });
          
          if (response.ok) {
            const result = await response.json();
            if (result.success && result.data && result.data._id) {
              newProductId = result.data._id;
            }
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Backend create failed", err);
        }
        
        addProduct({
          id: newProductId,
          rating: 0,
          reviews: 0,
          license: 'Standard',
          features: [],
          includedFiles: [],
          ...productData
        });
        toast.success('Product created successfully!');
      }
      
      navigate('/admin/products');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('An error occurred while saving.');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'general', label: 'General', icon: FileText },
    { id: 'pricing', label: 'Pricing', icon: IndianRupee },
    { id: 'media', label: 'Media', icon: ImageIcon },
    { id: 'details', label: 'Details', icon: Layers },
    { id: 'seo', label: 'SEO & Policies', icon: HelpCircle },
    { id: 'visibility', label: 'Visibility', icon: ShieldCheck },
  ];

  const currentTabIndex = tabs.findIndex(t => t.id === activeTab);
  
  const handleNext = () => {
    if (activeTab === 'general') {
      if (!title.trim() || !slug.trim() || !category || !tagsInput.trim() || !description.trim() || !detailedDescription.trim()) {
        toast.error('All fields in General tab are mandatory.');
        return;
      }
    }
    
    if (activeTab === 'pricing') {
      const parsedPrice = parseFloat(price);
      if (isNaN(parsedPrice) || parsedPrice < 0) {
        toast.error('Valid Regular Price is mandatory.');
        return;
      }
    }

    if (activeTab === 'media') {
      if (!coverImagePreview) {
        toast.error('Cover Image is mandatory.');
        return;
      }
      if (galleryImages.some(img => !img || img.trim() === '')) {
        toast.error('All 3 gallery images must be uploaded.');
        return;
      }
    }

    if (activeTab === 'details') {
      if (!whatsIncluded.trim() || !googleDriveFileId.trim() || !softwareRequired.trim() || !version.trim() || !brand.trim() || stock === '' || sold === '' || !seller.trim()) {
        toast.error('All fields in Details tab are mandatory.');
        return;
      }
      if (parseInt(sold) < 0) {
        toast.error('Sold Count cannot be negative.');
        return;
      }
      if (parseInt(stock) < 0) {
        toast.error('Stock Level cannot be negative.');
        return;
      }
    }

    if (activeTab === 'seo') {
      if (!seoTitle.trim() || !seoDescription.trim() || !metaKeywords.trim() || !refundPolicy.trim() || !supportInfo.trim()) {
        toast.error('All fields in SEO & Policies tab are mandatory.');
        return;
      }
    }

    if (activeTab === 'visibility') {
      if (!status || downloadLimit === '') {
        toast.error('All fields in Visibility tab are mandatory.');
        return;
      }
    }

    if (currentTabIndex < tabs.length - 1) setActiveTab(tabs[currentTabIndex + 1].id);
  };
  
  const handlePrev = () => {
    if (currentTabIndex > 0) setActiveTab(tabs[currentTabIndex - 1].id);
  };

  return (
    <div className="pb-12 max-w-6xl mx-auto">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-8">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <button 
            onClick={() => navigate('/admin/products')}
            className="p-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors"
          >
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
          </button>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">{isEditing ? 'Edit Product' : 'Add New Product'}</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">{isEditing ? 'Update existing product details.' : 'Create a new digital asset for your marketplace.'}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
            Discard
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8">
        {/* Left Sidebar Tabs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-1 space-y-1">
          {tabs.map((tab, idx) => (
            <div
              key={tab.id}
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold transition-all ${
                activeTab === tab.id 
                  ? 'bg-primary text-white shadow-md' 
                  : idx < currentTabIndex 
                    ? 'text-primary bg-primary/5' 
                    : 'text-slate-500'
              }`}
            >
              <tab.icon size={18} />
              {tab.label}
              {idx < currentTabIndex && <CheckCircle size={16} className="ml-auto" />}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Right Form Content */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-3 space-y-6">
          
          {/* General Tab */}
          {activeTab === 'general' && (
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">General Information</h2>
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Product Name</label>
                <input type="text" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Ultimate UI Kit" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900" />
              </div>
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Slug (URL)</label>
                <input type="text" value={slug} onChange={(e) => setSlug(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. ultimate-ui-kit" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900" />
              </div>
              
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Category</label>
                  <select value={category} onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)} className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900">
                    <option value="">Select Category...</option>

                      <option key={c.id} value={c.name}>{c.name}</option>
```
