```tsx
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Tags (Comma separated)</label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Tag size={18} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-600" />
                    <input type="text" value={tagsInput} onChange={(e) => setTagsInput(e.target.value)} placeholder="react, design, figma" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl pl-10 pr-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Short Description</label>
                <textarea rows={2} value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} placeholder="A brief summary of the product..." className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900 resize-none"></textarea>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Detailed Description</label>
                <textarea rows={6} value={detailedDescription} onChange={(e) => setDetailedDescription(e.target.value)} placeholder="Full markdown or HTML description..." className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900 resize-none"></textarea>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Pricing Tab */}
          {activeTab === 'pricing' && (
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">Pricing Strategy</h2>
              
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Regular Price (₹)</label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <IndianRupee size={18} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-600" />
                    <input type="number" value={price} onChange={(e) => setPrice(e.target.value)} placeholder="499" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl pl-10 pr-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900 font-bold" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Media Tab */}
          {activeTab === 'media' && (
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">Media Assets</h2>
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Cover Image (Required)</label>
                <label className="border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-2xl p-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer group relative overflow-hidden">
                  <input type="file" className="hidden" accept="image/*" onChange={handleCoverImageChange} />
                  {coverImagePreview ? (
                    <img src={coverImagePreview} alt="Cover Preview" className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover" />
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-slate-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 group-hover:bg-primary/10 transition-colors">
                        <UploadCloud size={28} className="text-slate-600 group-hover:text-primary transition-colors" />
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-slate-900 font-bold mb-1">Click to upload cover image</p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">PNG, JPG, or WEBP up to 5MB</p>
                    </>
                  )}
                </label>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Gallery & Preview Images (3 Slots)</label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                  {[0, 1, 2].map((index) => (
                    <label key={index} className="border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-2xl aspect-video flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer group relative overflow-hidden">
                      <input 
                        type="file" 
                        className="hidden" 
                        accept="image/*" 
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
                            const file = e.target.files[0];
                            const newGallery = [...galleryImages];
                            newGallery[index] = URL.createObjectURL(file);
                            setGalleryImages(newGallery);
                          }
                        }} 
                      />
                      {galleryImages[index] ? (
                        <div className="relative w-full h-full group/image">
                          <img src={galleryImages[index]} alt={`Gallery slot ${index + 1}`} className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover" />
                          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 opacity-0 group-hover/image:opacity-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-opacity">
                            <span className="text-slate-900 text-xs font-semibold">Change</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-slate-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-2 group-hover:bg-primary/10 transition-colors">
                            <ImageIcon size={18} className="text-slate-600 group-hover:text-primary transition-colors" />
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">Slot {index + 1}</p>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Details Tab */}
          {activeTab === 'details' && (
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">Product Specifications</h2>
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">What's Included</label>
                <textarea rows={3} value={whatsIncluded} onChange={(e) => setWhatsIncluded(e.target.value)} placeholder="- 50+ Figma files&#10;- React components&#10;- Lifetime updates" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900 resize-none font-mono text-sm"></textarea>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Google Drive File ID</label>
                <input type="text" value={googleDriveFileId} onChange={(e) => setGoogleDriveFileId(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 1A2b3C4d5E6f7G8h9I0j" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900" />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Software Required</label>
                  <input type="text" value={softwareRequired} onChange={(e) => setSoftwareRequired(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Figma, React, Node.js" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Version</label>
                  <input type="text" value={version} onChange={(e) => setVersion(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 2.1.0" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900" />
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div className="border-t border-slate-100 pt-6">
                <h3 className="text-md font-bold text-slate-900 mb-4">Inventory & Attributes</h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Brand</label>
                    <input type="text" value={brand} onChange={e => setBrand(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Nike, Apple" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary text-slate-900" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Stock Level</label>
                    <input type="number" min="0" value={stock} onChange={e => setStock(e.target.value)} placeholder="0" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary text-slate-900" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Sold Count</label>
                    <input type="number" min="0" value={sold} onChange={e => setSold(e.target.value)} placeholder="0" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary text-slate-900" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Seller/Vendor</label>
                    <input type="text" value={seller} onChange={e => setSeller(e.target.value)} placeholder="Seller Name" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary text-slate-900" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* SEO Tab */}
          {activeTab === 'seo' && (
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">SEO & Support Policies</h2>
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">SEO Title</label>
                <input type="text" value={seoTitle} onChange={(e) => setSeoTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="Title for search engines..." className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900" />
              </div>
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">SEO Description</label>
                <textarea rows={2} value={seoDescription} onChange={(e) => setSeoDescription(e.target.value)} placeholder="Meta description..." className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900 resize-none"></textarea>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Meta Keywords</label>
                <input type="text" value={metaKeywords} onChange={(e) => setMetaKeywords(e.target.value)} placeholder="comma, separated, keywords" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900" />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-100">
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Refund Policy</label>
                <select value={refundPolicy} onChange={(e) => setRefundPolicy(e.target.value)} className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900 mb-4">
                  <option>5-Day Money Back</option>
                  <option>10-Day Money Back</option>
                  <option>No Refunds (Digital Download)</option>
                </select>

                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Support Information</label>
                <textarea rows={2} value={supportInfo} onChange={(e) => setSupportInfo(e.target.value)} placeholder="How to get help..." className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900 resize-none"></textarea>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Visibility Tab */}
          {activeTab === 'visibility' && (
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">Product Visibility</h2>
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-4">Store Status</label>
                <div className="flex gap-4">
                  <label className={`flex-1 flex items-center gap-3 p-4 border rounded-xl cursor-pointer ${status === 'Active' ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5' : 'border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'}`}>
                    <input type="radio" name="status" value="Active" checked={status === 'Active'} onChange={() => setStatus('Active')} className="hidden" />
                    {status === 'Active' ? <CheckCircle size={20} className="text-primary" /> : <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2 border-slate-300"></div>}
                    <div>
                      <p className={`font-bold ${status === 'Active' ? 'text-primary' : 'text-slate-700'}`}>Published</p>
                      <p className={`text-xs ${status === 'Active' ? 'text-primary/70' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>Visible to everyone</p>
                    </div>
                  </label>
                  <label className={`flex-1 flex items-center gap-3 p-4 border rounded-xl cursor-pointer ${status === 'Draft' ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5' : 'border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'}`}>
                    <input type="radio" name="status" value="Draft" checked={status === 'Draft'} onChange={() => setStatus('Draft')} className="hidden" />
                    {status === 'Draft' ? <CheckCircle size={20} className="text-primary" /> : <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2 border-slate-300"></div>}
                    <div>
                      <p className={`font-bold ${status === 'Draft' ? 'text-primary' : 'text-slate-700'}`}>Hidden / Draft</p>
                      <p className={`text-xs ${status === 'Draft' ? 'text-primary/70' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>Only visible to admins</p>
                    </div>
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">Download Limit</label>
                <input type="number" value={downloadLimit} onChange={(e) => setDownloadLimit(e.target.value)} placeholder="Leave blank for unlimited" className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-slate-900" />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-6 border-t border-slate-100 space-y-4">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={isFeatured} onChange={(e) => setIsFeatured(e.target.checked)} className="w-5 h-5 rounded border-slate-300 text-primary focus:ring-primary" />
                  <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">Mark as Featured Product</span>
                </label>
                <label className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={isBestSeller} onChange={(e) => setIsBestSeller(e.target.checked)} className="w-5 h-5 rounded border-slate-300 text-primary focus:ring-primary" />
                  <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">Mark as Best Seller</span>
                </label>
                <label className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={isNewArrival} onChange={(e) => setIsNewArrival(e.target.checked)} className="w-5 h-5 rounded border-slate-300 text-primary focus:ring-primary" />
                  <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">Mark as New Arrival</span>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Navigation Buttons */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-4 mt-8 border-t border-slate-100 pt-6">
            {currentTabIndex > 0 && (
              <button
                onClick={handlePrev}
                className="px-8 py-3 bg-primary/10 text-primary rounded-xl text-sm font-bold hover:bg-primary/20 transition-colors"
              >
                Previous Step
              </button>
            )}
            
            {currentTabIndex < tabs.length - 1 ? (
              <button
                onClick={handleNext}
                className="px-8 py-3 bg-primary text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-bold hover:bg-primary/90 transition-colors shadow-sm"
              >
                Next Step
              </button>
            ) : (
              <Button onClick={handleSave} isLoading={isSaving} className="px-8 py-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl shadow-sm text-sm font-bold">
                <Save size={18} />
                Save Product
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.tsx
```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Search, Plus, Filter, MoreVertical, Edit2, Trash2, Eye } from 'lucide-react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { useStore } from '../../store/useStore';
import { formatCurrency } from '../../utils/currency';
import { exportToCSV } from '../../utils/csvExport';

export default function AdminProducts() {
  const { products, removeProduct } = useStore();
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleDelete = (id: string, title: string) => {
    if (window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete "${title}"? This cannot be undone.`)) {
      removeProduct(id);
      toast.success("Product deleted successfully");
    }
  };

  const handleAddProduct = () => {
    navigate('/admin/products/new');
  };

  const filteredProducts = products.filter(p => {
    const title = p.title || (p as any).name || '';
    const category = (typeof p.category === 'object' ? (p.category as any).name : p.category) || '';
    return title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
           category.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
  });

  const handleExport = () => {
    const exportData = filteredProducts.map(p => ({
      ID: p.id,
      Title: p.title || (p as any).name || 'Untitled',
      Category: (typeof p.category === 'object' ? (p.category as any).name : p.category) || 'Uncategorized',
      Price: p.price,
      Sales: p.reviews * 3,
      Status: 'Published'
    }));
    exportToCSV(exportData, 'products_export');
    toast.success('Products exported successfully');
  };

  const handleMockAction = (action: string) => {
    toast.success(`${action} feature coming soon!`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-12">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">Products</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 mt-1">Manage your digital downloads, templates, and courses.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button 
            onClick={handleExport}
            className="bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors text-sm flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-center"
          >
            <Filter size={18} />
            Export Data
          </button>
          <button 
            onClick={handleAddProduct}
            className="bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-white font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors text-sm flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-center"
          >
            <Plus size={18} />
            Add Product
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table Controls */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-t-2xl border-x border-t border-slate-200 p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4">
        <div className="relative w-full sm:max-w-xs">
          <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-600" />
          <input 
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search products..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <button className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 w-full sm:w-auto justify-center">
            <Filter size={16} /> Filter
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Data Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-b-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
            <thead className="bg-slate-50/50 text-slate-500 font-semibold border-b border-slate-200">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Product</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Status</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Category</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Price</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4">Sales</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {filteredProducts.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={6} className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-slate-500">
                    No products found matching "{searchTerm}".
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredProducts.map((product) => (
                  <tr key={product.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors group">
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <img src={product.coverImage} alt={product.title} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg object-cover border border-slate-100" />
                        <div>
                          <p className="font-bold text-slate-900 truncate max-w-[250px]">{product.title || (product as any).name || 'Untitled'}</p>
                          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">ID: {product.id}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-full border ${product.status === 'ACTIVE' || product.status === 'Published' ? 'bg-success/10 text-success border-success/20' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200'}`}>
                        {product.status || 'Published'}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-600 font-medium">
                      {typeof product.category === 'object' ? (product.category as any).name : product.category}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-900">
                      {formatCurrency(product.price)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-600 font-medium">
                      {product.sales !== undefined ? product.sales : 0}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Link to={`/product/${product.id}`} target="_blank" title="View in Shop" className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-success transition-colors">
                            <Eye size={16} />
                          </Link>
                          <Link to={`/admin/products/edit/${product.id}`} title="Edit" className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                            <Edit2 size={16} />
                          </Link>
                          <button onClick={() => handleDelete(product.id, product.title || (product as any).name || 'Untitled')} title="Delete" className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-danger transition-colors">
                            <Trash2 size={16} />
                          </button>
                          <button onClick={() => handleMockAction('More Options')} className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors">
                            <MoreVertical size={16} />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        
        {/* Pagination */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-slate-500">
          <span>Showing 1 to {filteredProducts.length} of {filteredProducts.length} entries</span>
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            <button className="px-3 py-1 border border-slate-200 rounded text-slate-600 cursor-not-allowed">Previous</button>
            <button className="px-3 py-1 border border-slate-200 rounded text-slate-600 cursor-not-allowed">Next</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminReports.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Download, FileText, Filter, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import SEO from '../../components/SEO';
import { formatCurrency } from '../../utils/currency';

export default function AdminReports() {
  const { token, logout } = useAuth();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [reportType, setReportType] = useState('sales');
  const [dateRange, setDateRange] = useState('30days');

  const fetchReport = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/analytics/reports?type=${reportType}&range=${dateRange}`, {
        headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      
      if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
        logout();
        return;
      }
      
      const data = await res.json();
      setReportData(data.data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) fetchReport();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [token, reportType, dateRange]);

  const handleDownloadCSV = () => {
    if (!reportData.length) return;
    
    // Convert to CSV
    const headers = Object.keys(reportData[0]).join(',');
    const rows = reportData.map(row => 
      Object.values(row).map(val => `"${val}"`).join(',')
    ).join('\n');
    
    const csv = `${headers}\n${rows}`;
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${reportType}-report-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <SEO title="Reports | Admin" description="Admin Reports" />
      
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-2">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">Reports</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 mt-1">Generate and download detailed system reports.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button 
            onClick={handleDownloadCSV}
            disabled={!reportData.length || loading}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors text-sm disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <Download size={16} /> Export CSV
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Filter size={18} className="text-slate-600" />
          <select 
            value={reportType}
            onChange={(e) => setReportType(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 text-sm rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary font-medium"
          >
            <option value="sales">Sales & Revenue</option>
            <option value="taxes">Tax Collection</option>
            <option value="inventory">Inventory Status</option>
            <option value="customers">Customer Acquisition</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Calendar size={18} className="text-slate-600" />
          <select 
            value={dateRange}
            onChange={(e) => setDateRange(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 text-sm rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary font-medium"
          >
            <option value="7days">Last 7 Days</option>
            <option value="30days">Last 30 Days</option>
            <option value="90days">Last 90 Days</option>
            <option value="year">This Year</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden min-h-[400px]">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-64 text-slate-600">
            <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-primary mb-4"></div>
            Generating Report...
          </div>
        ) : reportData.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-64 text-slate-600">
            <FileText size={48} className="mb-4 opacity-20" />
            <p>No data found for this period.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
              <thead className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                <tr>
                  {Object.keys(reportData[0]).map((key) => (
                    <th key={key} className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">
                      {key.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').trim()}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {reportData.map((row, i) => (
                  <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                    {Object.values(row).map((val: any, j) => (
                      <td key={j} className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-700">
                        {typeof val === 'number' && Object.keys(row)[j].toLowerCase().includes('amount') || Object.keys(row)[j].toLowerCase().includes('revenue') 
                          ? formatCurrency(val) 
                          : val}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminReviews.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { MessageSquare, Star, Trash2, Check, X, Search, Filter, ShieldAlert, Reply, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import Button from '../../components/Button';
import axios from 'axios';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

interface Review {
  _id: string;
  product: { _id: string, name: string, coverImage: string };
  customerName: string;
  rating: number;
  title: string;
  comment: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'hidden';
  createdAt: string;
  creatorReply?: { text: string };
}

export default function AdminReviews() {
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState<Review[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [replyText, setReplyText] = useState<{ [key: string]: string }>({});
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('all'); // all, pending, reported

  const fetchReviews = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await axios.get('/api/reviews/admin', {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      if (res.data.success) {
        setReviews(res.data.data);
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Failed to load reviews');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchReviews();
  }, []);

  const handleUpdateStatus = async (id: string, status: string) => {
    try {
      const res = await axios.put(`/api/reviews/admin/${id}/status`, { status }, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      if (res.data.success) {
        toast.success(`Review ${status}`);
        fetchReviews();
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Failed to update status');
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this review?')) return;
    try {
      const res = await axios.delete(`/api/reviews/admin/${id}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      if (res.data.success) {
        toast.success('Review deleted');
        fetchReviews();
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Failed to delete review');
    }
  };

  const handleReply = async (id: string) => {
    const text = replyText[id];
    if (!text) return;
    try {
      const res = await axios.post(`/api/reviews/${id}/reply`, { text }, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      if (res.data.success) {
        toast.success('Reply posted');
        setReplyText({ ...replyText, [id]: '' });
        fetchReviews();
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Failed to post reply');
    }
  };

  const filteredReviews = reviews.filter(r => {
    const matchesSearch = r.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
                          r.comment.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
                          (r.product && r.product.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));
    
    if (activeTab === 'pending') return matchesSearch && r.status === 'pending';
    if (activeTab === 'reported') return matchesSearch && r.status === 'hidden'; // Example logic for reported
    return matchesSearch;
  });

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    switch(status) {
      case 'approved': return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-green-100 text-green-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-full border border-green-200">Approved</span>;
      case 'rejected': return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-red-100 text-red-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-full border border-red-200">Rejected</span>;
      case 'hidden': return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-full border border-gray-200"><AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 inline mr-1"/>Hidden</span>;
      default: return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-full border border-amber-200">Pending</span>;
    }
  };

  const stats = {
    total: reviews.length,
    pending: reviews.filter(r => r.status === 'pending').length,
    avg: reviews.length > 0 ? (reviews.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length).toFixed(1) : '0',
    reported: reviews.filter(r => r.status === 'hidden').length
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center h-64"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-4 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
            <MessageSquare className="text-blue-600" />
            Review Management
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Monitor, moderate, and reply to customer feedback.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Stats Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-center">
          <span className="text-gray-500 text-sm font-medium">Total Reviews</span>
          <span className="text-3xl font-black text-gray-900 mt-1">{stats.total}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-center">
          <span className="text-amber-600 text-sm font-medium">Pending Approval</span>
          <span className="text-3xl font-black text-amber-700 mt-1">{stats.pending}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-center relative overflow-hidden">
          <span className="text-gray-500 text-sm font-medium">Average Rating</span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
            <span className="text-3xl font-black text-gray-900">{stats.avg}</span>
            <Star className="w-6 h-6 text-yellow-400 fill-yellow-400" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50/30 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-center">
          <span className="text-red-600 text-sm font-medium">Reported / Spam</span>
          <span className="text-3xl font-black text-red-700 mt-1">{stats.reported}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filters and Search */}
      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4 justify-between items-center">
        <div className="flex gap-2 bg-gray-100 p-1 rounded-lg w-full md:w-auto">
          <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('all')} className={`flex-1 md:flex-none px-4 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${activeTab === 'all' ? 'bg-white shadow-sm text-gray-900' : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900'}`}>All</button>
          <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('pending')} className={`flex-1 md:flex-none px-4 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${activeTab === 'pending' ? 'bg-white shadow-sm text-amber-700' : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-amber-700'}`}>
            Pending {stats.pending > 0 && <span className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs">{stats.pending}</span>}
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('reported')} className={`flex-1 md:flex-none px-4 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${activeTab === 'reported' ? 'bg-white shadow-sm text-red-700' : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-red-700'}`}>
            <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Reported
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-md w-full">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" size={18} />
          <input 
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search by customer, product, or comment..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Reviews List */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {filteredReviews.length > 0 ? filteredReviews.map((review) => (
          <div key={review._id} className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-6">
            <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row justify-between gap-6">
              
              {/* Left Column: Info & Content */}
              <div className="flex-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
                      {review.customerName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-bold text-gray-900">{review.customerName}</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">{new Date(review.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    {getStatusBadge(review.status)}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {review.product && (
                  <div className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-100">
                    <img src={review.product.coverImage || '/placeholder.png'} alt="product" className="w-6 h-6 rounded object-cover" />
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">{review.product.name}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex mb-2">
                  {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
                    <Star key={i} size={16} fill={i < review.rating ? '#fbbf24' : 'none'} className={i < review.rating ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-gray-300'} />
                  ))}
                </div>

                <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-900 mb-1">{review.title}</h4>
                <p className="text-gray-700 text-sm leading-relaxed mb-4">{review.comment}</p>

                {/* Creator Reply Section */}
                {review.creatorReply?.text ? (
                  <div className="bg-blue-50/50 border-l-2 border-blue-500 p-3 rounded-r-lg mt-4">
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-800 mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Reply className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Your Reply
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-700">{review.creatorReply.text}</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2">
                    <input 
                      type="text" 
                      placeholder="Write a public reply..." 
                      value={replyText[review._id] || ''}
                      onChange={(e) => setReplyText({...replyText, [review._id]: e.target.value})}
                      className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
                    />
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => handleReply(review._id)}
                      disabled={!replyText[review._id]}
                      className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 text-white text-sm font-medium rounded-lg disabled:opacity-50 hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors"
                    >
                      Reply
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Right Column: Actions */}
              <div className="lg:w-48 lg:border-l lg:border-gray-100 lg:pl-6 flex flex-row lg:flex-col gap-2 pt-4 lg:pt-0 border-t border-gray-100 lg:border-t-0">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 hidden lg:block">Actions</span>
                
                {review.status !== 'approved' && (
                  <button onClick={() => handleUpdateStatus(review._id, 'approved')} className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-green-50 text-green-700 hover:bg-green-100 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors">
                    <Check size={16} /> Approve
                  </button>
                )}
                
                {review.status !== 'rejected' && (
                  <button onClick={() => handleUpdateStatus(review._id, 'rejected')} className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-red-50 text-red-700 hover:bg-red-100 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors">
                    <X size={16} /> Reject
                  </button>
                )}

                <button onClick={() => handleDelete(review._id)} className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-red-600 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors lg:mt-auto">
                  <Trash2 size={16} /> Delete
                </button>
              </div>

            </div>
          </div>
        )) : (
          <div className="text-center p-12 bg-white rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-300">
            <MessageSquare size={32} className="mx-auto text-gray-400 mb-3" />
            <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">No reviews found</h3>
            <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm mt-1">Try adjusting your filters or search term.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Settings, Save, Store, CreditCard, Truck, Link as LinkIcon, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import Button from '../../components/Button';
import axios from 'axios';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

interface SettingItem {
  key: string;
  value: any;
  group: string;
}

export default function AdminSettings() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('general');
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<Record<string, any>>({
    store_name: 'Kanishk Digital World',
    support_email: '',
    support_phone: '',
    store_address: '',
    
    razorpay_key_id: '',
    razorpay_key_secret: '',
    currency: 'INR',
    tax_rate: '0',
    
    default_shipping_cost: '0',
    free_shipping_threshold: '500',
    
    facebook_url: '',
    instagram_url: '',
    twitter_url: ''
  });
  
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchSettings = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await axios.get('/api/admin/settings', {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
        });
        if (res.data.success && res.data.data.length > 0) {
          const fetched: Record<string, any> = { ...settings };
          res.data.data.forEach((s: SettingItem) => {
            fetched[s.key] = s.value;
          });
          setSettings(fetched);
        }
      } catch (_err) {
        toast.error('Failed to load settings');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchSettings();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const updates = [
        { key: 'store_name', value: settings.store_name, group: 'general' },
        { key: 'support_email', value: settings.support_email, group: 'general' },
        { key: 'support_phone', value: settings.support_phone, group: 'general' },
        { key: 'store_address', value: settings.store_address, group: 'general' },
        
        { key: 'razorpay_key_id', value: settings.razorpay_key_id, group: 'payment' },
        { key: 'razorpay_key_secret', value: settings.razorpay_key_secret, group: 'payment' },
        { key: 'currency', value: settings.currency, group: 'payment' },
        { key: 'tax_rate', value: settings.tax_rate, group: 'payment' },
        
        { key: 'default_shipping_cost', value: settings.default_shipping_cost, group: 'shipping' },
        { key: 'free_shipping_threshold', value: settings.free_shipping_threshold, group: 'shipping' },
        
        { key: 'facebook_url', value: settings.facebook_url, group: 'social' },
        { key: 'instagram_url', value: settings.instagram_url, group: 'social' },
        { key: 'twitter_url', value: settings.twitter_url, group: 'social' },
      ];

      const res = await axios.put('/api/admin/settings', updates, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      
      if (res.data.success) {
        toast.success('Settings saved successfully!');
      }
    } catch (_err) {
      toast.error('Failed to save settings');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleChange = (key: string, value: string) => {
    setSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center h-64"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div></div>;
  }

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'general', label: 'General', icon: <Store size={18} /> },
    { id: 'payment', label: 'Payment API', icon: <CreditCard size={18} /> },
    { id: 'shipping', label: 'Shipping', icon: <Truck size={18} /> },
    { id: 'social', label: 'Social Links', icon: <LinkIcon size={18} /> },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="p-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Settings className="text-primary" />
            Global Settings
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Configure global platform settings, API keys, and business details.</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={handleSave} isLoading={saving} className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Save size={18} />
          Save Changes
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-8">
        
        {/* Sidebar Tabs */}
        <div className="w-full lg:w-64 flex-shrink-0">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
            {tabs.map(tab => (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                className={`w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-4 text-sm font-bold border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0 transition-colors ${
                  activeTab === tab.id ? 'bg-primary/5 text-primary border-r-2 border-r-primary' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'
                }`}
              >
                {tab.icon}
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Content Area */}
        <div className="flex-1 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-6 shadow-sm min-h-[500px]">
          
          {activeTab === 'general' && (
            <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in">

                </div>
```

### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminShipping.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Truck, MapPin, Search, CheckCircle2, Clock, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import Button from '../../components/Button';
import axios from 'axios';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';
import { formatCurrency } from '../../utils/currency';

export default function AdminShipping() {
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchOrders();
  }, []);

  const fetchOrders = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await axios.get('/api/admin/orders', {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` }
      });
      if (res.data.success) {
        setOrders(res.data.data);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Failed to load orders for shipping.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const updateStatus = async (orderId: string, newStatus: string) => {
    try {
      const res = await axios.patch(`/api/admin/orders/${orderId}/status`, 
        { status: newStatus },
        { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}` } }
      );
      if (res.data.success) {
        toast.success(`Order status updated to ${newStatus}`);
        setOrders(orders.map(o => o._id === orderId ? { ...o, status: newStatus } : o));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Failed to update status');
    }
  };

  // Filter orders that need shipping/fulfillment attention
  const fulfillableOrders = orders.filter(o => 
    ['paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'completed'].includes(o.status)
  ).filter(o => 
    o.orderId.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || 
    (o.shippingAddress?.fullName || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
    (o.guestEmail || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    switch(status) {
      case 'paid': return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 rounded-md text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 w-fit"><AlertCircle size={12}/> Needs Fulfillment</span>;
      case 'processing': return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 rounded-md text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 w-fit"><Clock size={12}/> Processing</span>;
      case 'shipped': return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 rounded-md text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 w-fit"><Truck size={12}/> Shipped</span>;
      case 'completed': return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 rounded-md text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 w-fit"><CheckCircle2 size={12}/> Completed</span>;
      default: return <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 rounded-md text-xs font-bold">{status}</span>;
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center h-64"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Truck className="text-primary" />
            Shipping & Fulfillment
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Manage order fulfillment, update shipping statuses, and track deliveries.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="relative max-w-md w-full">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-600" size={18} />
            <input 
              type="text" 
              placeholder="Search by Order ID or Name..." 
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary text-sm"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
            <thead className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">Order ID / Date</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">Customer & Address</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">Items</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">Fulfillment Status</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {fulfillableOrders.map((order) => (
                <tr key={order._id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                  <td className="px-6 py-4">
                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-900">{order.orderId}</div>
                    <div className="text-slate-500 text-xs mt-1">{new Date(order.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4">
                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-800">{order.shippingAddress?.fullName || order.userId?.name || 'Guest'}</div>
                    <div className="text-slate-500 text-xs mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <MapPin size={12} />
                      {order.shippingAddress?.city ? `${order.shippingAddress.city}, ${order.shippingAddress.country}` : 'Digital Delivery'}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4">
                    <div className="text-slate-700">
                      {order.items.length} item(s) • {formatCurrency(order.totalAmount)}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4">
                    {getStatusBadge(order.status)}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                    <select 
                      className="bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary cursor-pointer"
                      value={order.status}
                      onChange={(e) => updateStatus(order._id, e.target.value)}
                    >
                      <option value="paid">Mark as Paid</option>
                      <option value="processing">Mark as Processing</option>
                      <option value="shipped">Mark as Shipped</option>
                      <option value="completed">Mark as Completed</option>
                    </select>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {fulfillableOrders.length === 0 && (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={5} className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-slate-500">
                    <Truck size={48} className="mx-auto text-slate-700 mb-4" />
                    <p className="font-medium text-slate-600">No orders require shipping right now.</p>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/admin/AdminSystemHealth.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Activity, Server, Cpu, Database, Clock } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';

export default function AdminSystemHealth() {
  const { token, logout } = useAuth();
  const [healthData, setHealthData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchHealth = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/health', {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
        });
        
        if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
          logout();
          return;
        }
        
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch system health');
        
        const data = await res.json();
        setHealthData(data.data);
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchHealth();
    // Refresh every 30 seconds
    const interval = setInterval(fetchHealth, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [token, logout]);

  if (loading && !healthData) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500">Loading System Health...</div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-8 text-center text-danger">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-2">Error Loading System Health</h2>
        <p>{error}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">System Health</h1>
        <div className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold ${healthData?.status === 'Healthy' ? 'bg-success/10 text-success' : 'bg-danger/10 text-danger'}`}>
          {healthData?.status || 'Unknown'}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
        <HealthCard 
          title="Database" 
          value={healthData?.database?.status} 
          subtitle={healthData?.database?.host} 
          icon={Database} 
        />
        <HealthCard 
          title="Memory Usage" 
          value={healthData?.server?.memory?.usagePercent} 
          subtitle={`${healthData?.server?.memory?.used} / ${healthData?.server?.memory?.total}`} 
          icon={Server} 
        />
        <HealthCard 
          title="CPU Cores" 
          value={healthData?.server?.cpu?.cores} 
          subtitle={healthData?.server?.cpu?.model} 
          icon={Cpu} 
        />
        <HealthCard 
          title="Uptime" 
          value={healthData?.server?.uptime?.system} 
          subtitle={`Node: ${healthData?.server?.uptime?.process}`} 
          icon={Clock} 
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function HealthCard({ title, value, subtitle, icon: Icon }: any) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-4">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500">{title}</h3>
        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Icon className="text-slate-600" size={20} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-1">{value}</div>
      <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 truncate" title={subtitle}>{subtitle}</div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import axios from 'axios';
import { ChevronRight, Home, ThumbsUp, ThumbsDown, FileText, Calendar, Eye, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import Button from '../components/Button';

export default function ArticleDetail() {
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const [article, setArticle] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [voted, setVoted] = useState<'helpful' | 'unhelpful' | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchArticle = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await axios.get(`/api/support/articles/${slug}`);
        if (res.data.success) {
          setArticle(res.data.data);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch article", err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    if (slug) fetchArticle();
  }, [slug]);

  const handleVote = async (isHelpful: boolean) => {
    if (voted || !article) return;
    try {
      await axios.post(`/api/support/articles/${article.id}/vote`, { helpful: isHelpful });
      setVoted(isHelpful ? 'helpful' : 'unhelpful');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Vote failed', err);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-[60vh] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-50">
        <Loader2 className="animate-spin text-primary" size={40} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!article) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-[60vh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 text-center px-6">
        <FileText size={64} className="text-slate-300 mb-6" />
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-4">Article Not Found</h1>
        <p className="text-slate-600 mb-8 max-w-md">The article you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.</p>
        <Link to="/docs">
          <Button>Back to Knowledge Base</Button>
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 pb-24">
      <SEO title={`${article.title} | Knowledge Base`} description={article.content.substring(0, 150)} />
      
      {/* Breadcrumbs */}
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-[72px] z-30">
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-6 py-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap">
          <Link to="/docs" className="hover:text-primary transition-colors flex items-center gap-1">
            <Home size={16} /> Knowledge Base
          </Link>
          <ChevronRight size={16} />
          {article.category && (
            <>
              <Link to={`/docs/category/${article.category.slug}`} className="hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                {article.category.name}
              </Link>
              <ChevronRight size={16} />
            </>
          )}
          <span className="text-slate-900 truncate max-w-xs">{article.title}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-6 mt-12">
        {/* Article Header */}
        <div className="mb-12">
          <h1 className="text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black text-slate-900 leading-tight mb-6 tracking-tight">
            {article.title}
          </h1>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6 text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-slate-200">
              <Calendar size={16} className="text-primary" />
              Last updated on {new Date(article.updatedAt).toLocaleDateString()}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-slate-200">
              <Eye size={16} className="text-accent" />
              {article.views + 1} views
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body (Markdown) */}
        <div className="bg-white p-8 md:p-12 rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 mb-12">
          <div className="prose prose-slate prose-lg max-w-none 
                          prose-headings:font-bold prose-headings:text-slate-900 
                          prose-a:text-primary hover:prose-a:text-primary/80
                          prose-img:rounded-xl prose-img:shadow-md
                          prose-code:text-primary prose-code:bg-primary/5 prose-code:px-1.5 prose-code:rounded
                          prose-pre:bg-slate-900 prose-pre:text-slate-100">
            <ReactMarkdown>{article.content}</ReactMarkdown>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Feedback Section */}
        <div className="bg-primary/5 border border-primary/20 p-8 rounded-3xl text-center">
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-6">Was this article helpful?</h3>
          
          {voted ? (
            <div className="text-success font-bold flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-success/20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                <ThumbsUp size={24} />
              </div>
              Thanks for your feedback!
              {voted === 'unhelpful' && (
                <div className="mt-4 text-slate-600 font-medium text-sm">
                  Still need help? <Link to="/support/ticket" className="text-primary hover:underline">Raise a Support Ticket</Link>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex justify-center gap-4">
              <button 
                onClick={() => handleVote(true)}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-primary hover:text-primary text-slate-600 font-bold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-sm"
              >
                <ThumbsUp size={20} /> Yes
              </button>
              <button 
                onClick={() => handleVote(false)}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-red-500 hover:text-red-500 text-slate-600 font-bold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-sm"
              >
                <ThumbsDown size={20} /> No
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
