### front end/src/pages/BundleDetails.tsx
```tsx
import { useParams, useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useStore } from '../store/useStore';
import { formatCurrency } from '../utils/currency';
import Button from '../components/Button';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import { 
  ShoppingCart, Star, Package, Check, ArrowLeft,
  Heart, Share2, Download, Zap, Shield, Crown, Lock, Smartphone, AlertTriangle
} from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import axios from 'axios';
import CheckoutModal from '../components/CheckoutModal';

export default function BundleDetails() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { bundles, addToCart, isCartOpen, setCartOpen } = useStore();
  const { isAuthenticated, token } = useAuth();
  const [isCheckoutOpen, setIsCheckoutOpen] = useState(false);
  
  const [ownedProducts, setOwnedProducts] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isCheckingOwnership, setIsCheckingOwnership] = useState(false);

  const bundle = bundles.find(b => b.id === id || b.slug === id);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (bundle && bundle.products && isAuthenticated && token) {
      checkOwnership();
    }
  }, [bundle, isAuthenticated, token]);

  const checkOwnership = async () => {
    if (!bundle || !bundle.products || bundle.products.length === 0) return;
    
    try {
      setIsCheckingOwnership(true);
      const productIds = bundle.products.map((p: any) => p.id);
      
      const res = await axios.post('/api/purchases/check-ownership', {
        productIds
      }, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      
      if (res.data.success) {
        setOwnedProducts(res.data.data.ownedProductIds || []);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to check ownership", error);
    } finally {
      setIsCheckingOwnership(false);
    }
  };

  if (!bundle) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-50">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Bundle not found</h1>
        <Button onClick={() => navigate('/bundles')}>Back to Bundles</Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const handleAddToCart = () => {
    const cartItem = {
      id: bundle.id,
      title: bundle.title,
      price: bundle.price,
      coverImage: bundle.coverImage,
      category: 'Bundle',
      type: 'bundle',
      quantity: 1
    };
    
    addToCart(cartItem);
    toast.success('Bundle added to cart!');
    if (!isCartOpen) setCartOpen(true);
  };

  const handleBuyNow = () => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (!token) {
      alert('Please login to buy bundles');
      return;
    }
    setIsCheckoutOpen(true);
  };

  const savings = bundle.originalPrice - bundle.price;

  const benefits = [
    { icon: Download, text: 'Instant Digital Download' },
    { icon: Zap, text: 'Lifetime Updates' },
    { icon: Shield, text: 'Commercial License' },
    { icon: Crown, text: 'Premium Quality' },
    { icon: Lock, text: 'Secure Payment' },
    { icon: Smartphone, text: 'Mobile Friendly' }
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen py-12 px-6 bg-slate-50">
      <SEO title={`${bundle.title} | Premium Bundle`} description={bundle.description} />
      <CheckoutModal 
        isOpen={isCheckoutOpen} 
        onClose={() => setIsCheckoutOpen(false)} 
        product={{ ...bundle, type: 'bundle' }} 
      />
      
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        <button 
          onClick={() => navigate('/bundles')}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 mb-8 transition-colors font-medium"
        >
          <ArrowLeft size={20} />
          Back to Bundles
        </button>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 lg:p-12 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 mb-16">
          
          {/* Left: Image */}
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="aspect-[4/3] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-100 relative group border border-slate-100">
              <img 
                src={bundle.coverImage} 
                alt={bundle.title} 
                className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-105"
              />
              <div className="absolute top-6 left-6 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/20 shadow-sm z-10">
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Package size={16} className="text-accent" />
                  {bundle.itemsIncluded} Products Included
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Bundle Benefits */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-6">
              {benefits.map((benefit, i) => {
                const Icon = benefit.icon;
                return (
                  <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-700">
                    <div className="bg-primary/10 text-primary p-2 rounded-lg">
                      <Icon size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                    </div>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-sm">{benefit.text}</span>
                  </div>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right: Content */}
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <div className="mb-8">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
                <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-accent/10 text-accent rounded-full text-xs font-bold tracking-wide uppercase">
                  Best Value
                </span>
                <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-success/10 text-success rounded-full text-xs font-bold tracking-wide uppercase">
                  Save {formatCurrency(savings)}
                </span>
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-yellow-500 text-sm font-bold bg-yellow-50 px-2 py-1 rounded-full">
                  <Star size={14} fill="currentColor" />
                  {bundle.rating} ({Math.floor(Math.random() * 500) + 100} Reviews)
                </span>
              </div>
              
              <h1 className="text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-4 tracking-tight">
                {bundle.title}
              </h1>
              
              <p className="text-lg text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                {bundle.description}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl p-8 border border-slate-200 mb-8">
              <div className="space-y-4 mb-8">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-slate-500">
                  <span className="font-medium">Total Value</span>
                  <span className="line-through text-lg">{formatCurrency(bundle.originalPrice)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-success">
                  <span className="font-bold">Bundle Discount</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">-{formatCurrency(savings)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-end pt-4 border-t border-slate-200">
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Bundle Price</span>
                  <span className="text-5xl font-black text-slate-900">{formatCurrency(bundle.price)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {ownedProducts.length > 0 && (
                <div className={`mb-6 p-4 rounded-xl flex gap-3 ${
                  ownedProducts.length === (bundle.products?.length || 0)
                    ? 'bg-success/10 text-success-dark border border-success/20'
                    : 'bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-800 border border-yellow-200'
                }`}>
                  <AlertTriangle size={24} className={ownedProducts.length === bundle.products?.length ? "text-success" : "text-yellow-600"} />
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-bold">
                      {ownedProducts.length === bundle.products?.length 
                        ? "You already own this complete bundle!" 
                        : `You already own ${ownedProducts.length} of the ${bundle.products?.length} products in this bundle.`
                      }
                    </h4>
                    {ownedProducts.length < (bundle.products?.length || 0) && (
                      <p className="text-sm mt-1">Purchasing this bundle will grant you access to the remaining products.</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {ownedProducts.length !== (bundle.products?.length || 0) && (
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 mb-4">
                  <Button 
                    size="lg" 
                    className="flex-1 text-lg h-14"
                    onClick={handleBuyNow}
                  >
                    Buy Bundle Now
                  </Button>
                  <Button 
                    variant="outline"
                    size="lg" 
                    className="flex-1 text-lg h-14 flex items-center justify-center gap-3"
                    onClick={handleAddToCart}
                  >
                    <ShoppingCart size={20} />
                    Add to Cart
                  </Button>
                </div>
              )}
              
              <div className="flex gap-4">
                <button 
                  onClick={() => toast.success('Added to wishlist')}
                  className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 font-semibold hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors"
                >
                  <Heart size={18} /> Wishlist
                </button>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => {
                    navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);
                    toast.success('Link copied to clipboard!');
                  }}
                  className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 font-semibold hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors"
                >
                  <Share2 size={18} /> Share
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Included Products Section */}
        {bundle.products && bundle.products.length > 0 && (
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-8 flex items-center gap-3">
              <Package className="text-primary" size={32} />
              Included in this bundle ({bundle.products.length})
            </h2>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {bundle.products.map((product: any) => (
                <div key={product.id} className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden flex flex-col group hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1">
                  <div className="relative aspect-video overflow-hidden">
                    <img 
                      src={product.thumbnail || product.coverImage} 
                      alt={product.name} 
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-105"
                    />
                    <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-primary flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm">
                      <Check size={14} /> Included
                    </div>
                    {ownedProducts.includes(product.id) && (
                      <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 bg-success/95 backdrop-blur-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Check size={14} /> You Own This
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="p-6 flex flex-col flex-1">
                    <div className="mb-4">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 block">
                        {(typeof product.category === 'object' ? product.category?.name : product.category) || 'Digital Product'}
                      </span>
                      <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 leading-tight mb-2 group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                        {product.name}
                      </h3>
                      <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 line-clamp-2">
                        {product.shortDescription || product.description}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="mt-auto pt-6 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 block mb-1">Individual Price</span>
                        <span className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900">{formatCurrency(product.price)}</span>
                      </div>
                      <Link to={`/product/${product.id}`} className="text-primary font-bold text-sm hover:underline flex items-center gap-1">
                        View Details
                      </Link>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
                  </div>
                  <button className="px-6 py-3 bg-white/10 hover:bg-accent hover:text-slate-900 text-white font-bold rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
                    <ShoppingBag size={18} />
                    Get Bundle
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ShoppingCart, Trash2, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useStore } from '../store/useStore';
import Button from '../components/Button';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import { formatCurrency } from '../utils/currency';

export default function Cart() {
  const { cart, removeFromCart, clearCart } = useStore();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const total = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price, 0);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen py-12 px-6 bg-slate-50">
      <SEO title="Your Cart | Kanishk Digital World" description="View and manage items in your shopping cart." />
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 mb-8 flex items-center gap-3">
          <ShoppingCart size={32} className="text-primary" />
          Your Shopping Cart
        </h1>

        {cart.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-12 text-center border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
            <div className="w-24 h-24 bg-slate-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
              <ShoppingCart size={40} className="text-slate-700" />
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-4">Your cart is empty</h2>
            <p className="text-slate-600 max-w-md mx-auto mb-8">
              Looks like you haven't added any premium templates or kits to your cart yet.
            </p>
            <Button onClick={() => navigate('/shop')} size="lg">
              Explore Products
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-8">
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-4">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
                <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/50 flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">{cart.length} Items</span>
                  <button onClick={clearCart} className="text-sm text-danger hover:underline">Clear Cart</button>
                </div>
                <div className="p-6 space-y-6">
                  {cart.map((item) => (
                    <div key={item.id} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-6 pb-6 border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0 last:pb-0">
                      <Link to={item.type === 'bundle' || item.category === 'Bundle' ? `/bundles/${item.id}` : `/product/${item.id}`} className="shrink-0">
                        <img src={item.coverImage} alt={item.title} className="w-full sm:w-32 aspect-video sm:aspect-square object-cover rounded-xl border border-slate-200" />
                      </Link>
                      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-4">
                            <Link to={item.type === 'bundle' || item.category === 'Bundle' ? `/bundles/${item.id}` : `/product/${item.id}`}>
                              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 hover:text-primary transition-colors">{item.title}</h3>
                            </Link>
                            <span className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900">{formatCurrency(item.price)}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">{item.type === 'bundle' ? 'Premium Bundle' : (typeof item.category === 'object' ? (item.category as any).name : item.category)}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex justify-end mt-4">
                          <button 
                            onClick={() => removeFromCart(item.id)}
                            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-500 hover:text-danger transition-colors"
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={16} /> Remove
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Order Summary */}
            <div className="w-full lg:w-96">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm sticky top-24">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 mb-6">Order Summary</h3>
                <div className="space-y-4 text-sm text-slate-600 border-b border-slate-100 pb-6 mb-6">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Subtotal</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{formatCurrency(total)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Taxes</span>
                    <span>Calculated at checkout</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-8">
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">Total</span>
                  <span className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">{formatCurrency(total)}</span>
                </div>
                <Button 
                  className="w-full flex justify-center items-center gap-2" 
                  size="lg"
                  onClick={() => navigate('/checkout')}
                >
                  Proceed to Checkout <ArrowRight size={18} />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

```tsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useStore } from '../store/useStore';
import { LayoutGrid } from 'lucide-react';

export default function Categories() {
  const { categories } = useStore();
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen py-12 px-6">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-8">
          <div className="p-3 bg-primary/20 rounded-xl text-primary">
            <LayoutGrid size={28} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">Browse Categories</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-600 mt-1">Explore our entire collection of premium digital assets.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          {categories.map(category => (
            <Link to={`/shop?category=${category.name}`} key={category.id} className="group relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden h-72 bg-slate-900 flex flex-col justify-end p-6 hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(37,99,235,0.25)] transition-all">
              <img 
                src={category.image} 
                alt={`Cover image for ${category.name}`} 
                loading="lazy"
                decoding="async"
                className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-40 transition-all duration-500 group-hover:scale-105" 
              />
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-900/95 via-slate-900/60 to-transparent"></div>
              <div className="relative z-10 translate-y-4 group-hover:translate-y-0 transition-transform duration-300">
                <span className="inline-block mb-3 px-3 py-1 bg-white/20 text-white border border-white/20 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold backdrop-blur-md">
                  {category.count} Products
                </span>
                <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2 leading-tight drop-shadow-sm">{category.name}</h3>
                <p className="text-slate-200 text-sm opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 delay-100">
                  {category.description}
                </p>
              </div>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/Checkout.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useStore } from '../store/useStore';
import Button from '../components/Button';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import { formatCurrency } from '../utils/currency';
import { ShieldCheck, CheckCircle, Lock, Tag, X } from 'lucide-react';
import axios from 'axios';

const loadRazorpayScript = () => {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = 'https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js';
    script.onload = () => resolve(true);
    script.onerror = () => resolve(false);
    document.body.appendChild(script);
  });
};

// Add Razorpay type to window
declare global {
  interface Window {
    Razorpay: any;
  }
}

export default function Checkout() {
  const { cart, clearCart, addOrder } = useStore();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    firstName: '',
    lastName: '',
    email: '',
    phone: ''
  });

  const [couponCode, setCouponCode] = useState('');
  const [appliedCoupon, setAppliedCoupon] = useState<{code: string, discountPercentage: number} | null>(null);
  const [availableCoupons, setAvailableCoupons] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [couponError, setCouponError] = useState('');
  const [isApplyingCoupon, setIsApplyingCoupon] = useState(false);

  const total = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price, 0);
  const discountAmount = appliedCoupon ? (total * appliedCoupon.discountPercentage) / 100 : 0;
  const finalTotal = total - discountAmount;

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchCoupons = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await axios.get('/api/coupons');
        if (res.data.success) {
          setAvailableCoupons(res.data.data);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch coupons');
      }
    };
    fetchCoupons();
  }, []);

  const handleApplyCoupon = async (e?: React.FormEvent, codeToApply?: string) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    const code = codeToApply || couponCode;
    if (!code.trim()) return;
    
    setIsApplyingCoupon(true);
    setCouponError('');
    try {
      const res = await axios.post('/api/coupons/validate', { code });
      if (res.data.success) {
        setAppliedCoupon(res.data.data);
        setCouponCode(res.data.data.code);
        setCouponError('');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setCouponError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Invalid coupon code');
      setAppliedCoupon(null);
    } finally {
      setIsApplyingCoupon(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveCoupon = () => {
    setAppliedCoupon(null);
    setCouponCode('');
    setCouponError('');
  };

  const handlePayment = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsProcessing(true);

    try {
      const res = await loadRazorpayScript();
      if (!res) {
        alert('Razorpay SDK failed to load. Are you online?');
        setIsProcessing(false);
        return;
      }

      // Step 1: Create Order in Backend
      // We map the cart items to what the backend expects
      const orderItems = cart.map(item => ({
        id: item.id,
        productId: item.type !== 'bundle' ? item.id : undefined,
        bundleId: item.type === 'bundle' ? item.id : undefined,
        type: item.type,
        name: item.title,
        price: item.price,
        quantity: 1
      }));

      // NOTE: This will fail if the PostgreSQL backend is not connected!
      let orderData;
      try {
        const orderResponse = await axios.post('/api/payments/create-order', {
          items: orderItems,
          guestName: formData.firstName + ' ' + formData.lastName,
          guestEmail: formData.email,
          couponCode: appliedCoupon?.code
        });
        if (!orderResponse.data.success) {
          throw new Error(orderResponse.data.message);
        }
        orderData = orderResponse.data.data;
      } catch (err: any) {
        const apiError = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Failed to create order on server.';
        throw new Error(apiError);
      }

      const verifyPaymentOnServer = async (razorpay_order_id: string, razorpay_payment_id: string, razorpay_signature: string) => {
        try {
          const verifyRes = await axios.post('/api/payments/verify-payment', {
            razorpay_order_id,
            razorpay_payment_id,
            razorpay_signature
          });

          if (verifyRes.data.success) {
            const order = {
              id: orderData.orderId,
              date: new Date().toISOString(),
              items: [...cart],
              total: finalTotal,
              status: 'completed'
            };
            addOrder(order);
            clearCart();
            navigate(`/payment-success/${order.id}`);
          } else {
            throw new Error(verifyRes.data.message || 'Verification failed');
          }
        } catch (err: any) {
          alert(err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Payment verification failed.');
        } finally {
          setIsProcessing(false);
        }
      };

      if (orderData.paymentMode === 'mock') {
        setIsProcessing(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          verifyPaymentOnServer(
            orderData.razorpayOrderId,
            'pay_mock_' + Date.now(),
            'sig_mock_dummy'
          );
        }, 1500);
        return;
      }

      // Step 2: Open Razorpay Modal
      const options: any = {
        key: import.meta.env.VITE_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID || '', 
        amount: orderData.amount, // Amount is in currency subunits.
        currency: orderData.currency,
        name: 'Kanishk Digital World',
        description: 'Complete your purchase',
        order_id: orderData.razorpayOrderId, // This is the order ID created in the backend
        handler: async function (response: any) {
          await verifyPaymentOnServer(
            response.razorpay_order_id,
            response.razorpay_payment_id,
            response.razorpay_signature
          );
        },
        prefill: {
          name: formData.firstName + ' ' + formData.lastName,
          email: formData.email,
          contact: formData.phone
        },
        theme: {
          color: '#2563EB' // blue-600
        },
        modal: {
          ondismiss: function() {
            setIsProcessing(false);
          }
        }
      };

      if (!options.key) {
        throw new Error("Razorpay Key ID is not configured in the frontend environment.");
      }

      const paymentObject = new window.Razorpay(options);
      paymentObject.on('payment.failed', function (response: any) {
        alert(response.error.description);
        setIsProcessing(false);
      });
      paymentObject.open();

    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Failed to initiate payment:', error);
      alert(error.message || 'Failed to initiate payment. Please make sure the backend database is connected.');
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  if (cart.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen py-24 px-6 bg-slate-50 flex flex-col items-center">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Your cart is empty</h1>
        <Button onClick={() => navigate('/shop')}>Return to Shop</Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen py-12 px-6 bg-slate-50">
      <SEO title="Checkout | Kanishk Digital World" description="Secure checkout." />
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
        
        {/* Payment Form */}
        <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-6 flex items-center gap-2">
            Secure Checkout
          </h2>
          
          <form onSubmit={handlePayment} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-4 mb-6">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">First Name</label>
                  <input required type="text" value={formData.firstName} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, firstName: e.target.value})} className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Last Name</label>
                  <input required type="text" value={formData.lastName} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, lastName: e.target.value})} className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50" />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Email Address</label>
                <input required type="email" value={formData.email} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, email: e.target.value})} className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Phone Number</label>
                <input required type="tel" value={formData.phone} onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, phone: e.target.value})} className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-6 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl mb-6">
              <p className="text-slate-600 text-sm leading-relaxed mb-4">
                You will be redirected to the secure <strong>Razorpay</strong> payment gateway to complete your purchase using UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, Netbanking, or Wallets.
              </p>
              <div className="flex gap-2 items-center opacity-70 grayscale">
                {/* Mock logos for trust */}
                <div className="h-8 w-12 bg-slate-200 rounded flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">UPI</div>
                <div className="h-8 w-12 bg-slate-200 rounded flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">VISA</div>
                <div className="h-8 w-12 bg-slate-200 rounded flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">MC</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="pt-4">
              <Button size="lg" className="w-full mt-8 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-lg" isLoading={isProcessing}>
                <Lock size={20} />
                Pay {formatCurrency(finalTotal)}
              </Button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 text-center flex items-center justify-center gap-1 mt-4">
              <ShieldCheck size={14} /> Payments are secure and encrypted.
            </p>
          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Order Summary */}
        <div className="bg-slate-100 p-8 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 h-fit">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-6">Order Summary</h2>
          <div className="space-y-4 mb-6 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto pr-2">
            {cart.map(item => (
              <div key={item.id} className="flex justify-between items-center text-sm gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1">
                  <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-slate-200 flex-shrink-0 overflow-hidden border border-slate-200">
                    <img 
                      src={item.coverImage || item.thumbnail || 'https://via.placeholder.com/150'} 
                      alt={item.title} 
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 line-clamp-1">{item.title}</h4>
                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">{item.type === 'bundle' ? 'Premium Bundle' : (typeof item.category === 'object' ? (item.category as any).name : item.category)}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{formatCurrency(item.price)}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="border-t border-slate-200 pt-4 space-y-3">
            
            {/* Coupon Section */}
            <div className="py-2">
              <form onSubmit={handleApplyCoupon} className="flex gap-2">
                <div className="relative flex-1">
                  <Tag size={18} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-600" />
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    placeholder="Discount code" 
                    value={couponCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setCouponCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                    disabled={!!appliedCoupon}
                    className="w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-lg pl-10 pr-4 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-sm uppercase font-medium disabled:bg-slate-100"
                  />
                </div>
                {!appliedCoupon ? (
                  <Button type="submit" isLoading={isApplyingCoupon} className="px-4 py-2">Apply</Button>
                ) : (
                  <button type="button" onClick={handleRemoveCoupon} className="px-4 py-2 bg-red-50 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-100 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm transition-colors flex items-center gap-1">
                    <X size={16} /> Remove
                  </button>
                )}
              </form>
              
              {couponError && <p className="text-red-500 text-xs font-bold mt-2">{couponError}</p>}
              
              {availableCoupons.length > 0 && !appliedCoupon && (
                <div className="mt-3">
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 mb-2 uppercase tracking-wider">Available Coupons</p>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {availableCoupons.map(c => (
                      <button 
                        key={c.code}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleApplyCoupon(undefined, c.code)}
                        className="text-xs font-bold bg-primary/10 text-primary border border-primary/20 px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-primary hover:text-white transition-colors"
                      >
                        {c.code} (-{c.discountPercentage}%)
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-slate-600">
              <span>Subtotal</span>
              <span>{formatCurrency(total)}</span>
            </div>
            
            {appliedCoupon && (
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-success font-medium">
                <span>Discount ({appliedCoupon.code})</span>
                <span>-{formatCurrency(discountAmount)}</span>
              </div>
            )}
            
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-3 border-t border-slate-200">
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">Total</span>
              <span className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">{formatCurrency(finalTotal)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Package, Download, FileText, Key, Settings, LogOut, Edit2, ShieldAlert, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useStore } from '../store/useStore';
import { formatCurrency } from '../utils/currency';
import { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function Dashboard() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('purchases');
  const { logout, user } = useAuth();
  const { orders } = useStore();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();
    navigate('/login');
  };

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'purchases', name: 'My Purchases', icon: Package },
    { id: 'downloads', name: 'Downloads', icon: Download },
    { id: 'invoices', name: 'Invoices', icon: FileText },
    { id: 'licenses', name: 'Licenses', icon: Key },
    { id: 'profile', name: 'Profile Settings', icon: Settings },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen py-12 px-6">
      <SEO title="Dashboard" description="Manage your purchases, downloads, and account settings." />
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-8">
        
        {/* Sidebar / Mobile Tabs */}
        <aside className="w-full md:w-64 flex-shrink-0">
          <div className="md:sticky top-24 glass p-4 md:p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
            <div className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-4 mb-8 pb-6 border-b border-slate-200">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-primary text-white rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xl shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(37,99,235,0.4)]">
                {user?.name ? user.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : 'U'}
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="font-bold text-slate-900">{user?.name || 'User'}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-slate-600">{user?.email || 'user@example.com'}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Scrollable Tabs on Mobile, Stacked on Desktop */}
            <nav className="flex overflow-x-auto md:flex-col gap-2 md:mb-8 pb-2 md:pb-0 hide-scrollbar -mx-2 px-2 md:mx-0 md:px-0">
              {tabs.map(tab => (
                <button 
                  key={tab.id}
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                  className={`flex-shrink-0 flex items-center gap-2 md:gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 md:py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-all focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:outline-none ${activeTab === tab.id ? 'bg-primary/10 text-primary border border-primary/20' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 border border-transparent'}`}
                >
                  <tab.icon size={18} className={activeTab === tab.id ? 'text-primary' : ''} aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{tab.name}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </nav>
            
            <button onClick={handleLogout} className="hidden md:flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium text-danger hover:bg-danger/10 transition-colors border border-transparent focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-danger focus-visible:outline-none">
              <LogOut size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
              Sign Out
            </button>
          </div>
        </aside>

        {/* Main Content */}
        <main className="flex-1 overflow-x-hidden">
          {activeTab === 'purchases' && (
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-8">My Purchases</h1>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {(!Array.isArray(orders) || orders.length === 0) ? (
                  <p className="text-slate-500">No purchases yet.</p>
                ) : orders.map(order => (
                  order.items?.map((item: any) => {
                    if (!item) return null;
                    const product = item.product || item;
                    if (!product) return null;
                    
                    return (
                    <div key={product.id || product._id || Math.random()} className="glass p-4 rounded-2xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-6 border border-slate-200 hover:shadow-md transition-all">
                      <img src={product.coverImage || 'https://placehold.co/400x300?text=No+Image'} alt={product.title || product.name || 'Product'} className="w-full sm:w-32 aspect-video object-cover rounded-lg" />
                      <div className="flex-1 w-full text-center sm:text-left">

                        >
                          <RotateCcw size={16} /> Request Refund
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'downloads' && (
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-8">Download History</h1>
              <div className="glass rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-slate-600 min-w-[600px]">
                    <thead className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 uppercase text-xs font-semibold border-b border-slate-200">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="px-6 py-4">File Name</th>
                        <th className="px-6 py-4">Size</th>
                        <th className="px-6 py-4">Date</th>
                        <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right">Action</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200">
                      <tr className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="p-2 bg-accent/10 text-accent rounded-lg"><Package size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></div>
                          SaaS_Framer_Template_v2.1.zip
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">45.2 MB</td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">Today at 10:42 AM</td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                          <button className="text-primary hover:text-primary/80 font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:outline-none rounded">Redownload</button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="p-2 bg-success/10 text-success rounded-lg"><FileText size={16} aria-hidden="true" /></div>
                          10k_Prompts_Marketing.csv
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">2.4 MB</td>
```

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { HelpCircle, ChevronDown, MessageCircle, Mail } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';

const faqs = [
  {
    category: 'Billing & Payments',
    questions: [
      {
        q: 'What payment methods do you accept?',
        a: 'We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and UPI (for customers in India).'
      },
      {
        q: 'Can I get a refund if I am not satisfied?',
        a: 'Yes, we offer a 14-day money-back guarantee on all our products if they do not function as described. Please refer to our Refund Policy for detailed terms.'
      },
      {
        q: 'Where can I find my invoice?',
        a: 'You can find all your invoices in your Dashboard under the "Order History" section. A PDF copy is also sent to your email immediately after purchase.'
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    category: 'Licenses & Usage',
    questions: [
      {
        q: 'Can I use templates for commercial projects?',
        a: 'Yes! Our standard license allows you to use the templates for commercial projects. However, you cannot resell the raw templates as your own.'
      },
      {
        q: 'Do I need to pay a recurring subscription fee?',
        a: 'No, all our current templates and kits are sold as one-time purchases with lifetime access to updates.'
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    category: 'Technical Support',
    questions: [
      {
        q: 'How do I download updates for my purchased products?',
        a: 'Whenever a product is updated, you can download the latest version from your Dashboard for free. We will also send you an email notification.'
      },
      {
        q: 'What if I need help setting up a template?',
        a: 'Our Knowledge Base contains step-by-step guides for all products. If you still need help, you can raise a support ticket and our team will assist you.'
      }
    ]
  }
];

export default function FAQ() {
  const [openIndex, setOpenIndex] = useState<string | null>('0-0');

  const toggleAccordion = (index: string) => {
    setOpenIndex(openIndex === index ? null : index);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 py-12 px-6">
      <SEO title="Frequently Asked Questions | KDW Marketplace" description="Find answers to common questions about billing, licenses, and support." />
      
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto pt-8 mb-16 text-center">
        <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 bg-primary/10 text-primary rounded-2xl mb-6">
          <HelpCircle size={32} />
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight mb-6">Frequently Asked Questions</h1>
        <p className="text-lg text-slate-600">
          Everything you need to know about KDW Marketplace. Can't find the answer you're looking for? Reach out to our support team.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto space-y-12 mb-20">
        {faqs.map((group, groupIdx) => (
          <div key={groupIdx}>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-6">{typeof group.category === 'object' ? (group.category as any).name : group.category}</h2>
            <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
              {group.questions.map((faq, faqIdx) => {
                const index = `${groupIdx}-${faqIdx}`;
                const isOpen = openIndex === index;
                
                return (
                  <div key={faqIdx} className="border-b border-slate-100 last:border-none">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => toggleAccordion(index)}
                      className="w-full flex items-center justify-between p-6 text-left focus:outline-none focus-visible:bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-lg pr-4">{faq.q}</span>
                      <ChevronDown 
                        size={20} 
                        className={`text-slate-400 transition-transform duration-300 shrink-0 ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180 text-primary' : ''}`} 
                      />
                    </button>
                    <AnimatePresence>
                      {isOpen && (
                        <motion.div
                          initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                          animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
                          exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                          transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
                          className="overflow-hidden"
                        >
                          <div className="p-6 pt-0 text-slate-600 leading-relaxed bg-slate-50/50">
                            {faq.a}
                          </div>
                        </motion.div>
                      )}
                    </AnimatePresence>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 border border-slate-200 text-center flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-6 shadow-sm">
        <div className="text-left flex-1">
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-2">Still have questions?</h3>
          <p className="text-slate-600">Our support team is here to help you 24/7.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 w-full md:w-auto">
          <Link to="/support/ticket" className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 bg-primary text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-primary-dark transition-colors">
            <MessageCircle size={18} /> Raise Ticket
          </Link>
          <a href="mailto:support@kdwmarketplace.com" className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors">
            <Mail size={18} /> Email Us
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/ForgotPassword.tsx
```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Mail, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { z } from 'zod';
import Button from '../components/Button';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';

const forgotSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string().email("Please enter a valid email address."),
});

type ForgotFormValues = z.infer<typeof forgotSchema>;

export default function ForgotPassword() {
  const { register, handleSubmit, formState: { errors, isSubmitting } } = useForm<ForgotFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(forgotSchema)
  });
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState('');
  const [tokenMsg, setTokenMsg] = useState('');

  const onSubmit = async (data: ForgotFormValues) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/auth/forgot-password', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      });

      const result = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(result.message || 'Failed to request reset');
      }

      setSuccessMessage('Password reset link has been simulated. See token below:');
      if (result.token) {
        setTokenMsg(result.token);
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      alert(error.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-[80vh] flex items-center justify-center px-4 relative overflow-hidden">
      <SEO title="Forgot Password" description="Reset your Kanishk Digital World password." />
      <div className="absolute top-1/4 -left-1/4 w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-primary/10 rounded-full blur-[100px] -z-10"></div>
      
      <div className="glass p-8 md:p-12 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md border border-slate-200 shadow-xl">
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 mb-2">Forgot Password</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-600">Enter your email to receive a reset link</p>
        </div>
        
        {successMessage ? (
          <div className="text-center">
            <div className="p-4 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-xl text-green-700 mb-6">
              {successMessage}
              {tokenMsg && (
                <div className="mt-2 text-xs font-mono bg-white p-2 rounded border border-green-100 break-all">
                  {tokenMsg}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            {tokenMsg && (
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 mb-6">
                Copy the token above and proceed to the <Link to={`/reset-password/${tokenMsg}`} className="text-primary font-semibold hover:underline">Reset Password</Link> page.
              </p>
            )}
            <Link to="/login" className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 hover:text-primary transition-colors">
              <ArrowLeft size={16} /> Back to Login
            </Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-5">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Email Address</label>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                  <Mail size={18} className={errors.email ? "text-danger" : "text-slate-600"} aria-hidden="true" />
                </div>
                <input 
                  id="email"
                  type="email" 
                  {...register("email")}
                  className={`w-full bg-slate-50 border ${errors.email ? 'border-danger focus:ring-danger/50' : 'border-slate-200 focus:ring-primary/50'} rounded-xl py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-all`}
                  placeholder="you@example.com"
                  aria-invalid={errors.email ? "true" : "false"}
                />
              </div>
              {errors.email && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger flex items-center gap-1" role="alert">{errors.email.message}</p>}
            </div>
            
            <Button type="submit" className="w-full mt-4" size="lg" isLoading={isSubmitting}>
              Send Reset Link <ArrowRight size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
            </Button>
            
            <div className="mt-6 text-center">
              <Link to="/login" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors">
                <ArrowLeft size={16} /> Back to Login
              </Link>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useLocation, Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { ChevronRight, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';

const formatTitle = (pathname: string) => {
  const segment = pathname.split('/').pop() || '';
  return segment
    .split('-')
    .map(word => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
    .join(' ');
};

export default function GenericPage() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const title = formatTitle(location.pathname);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-white">
      <SEO title={`${title} | KDW Marketplace`} description={`Read our ${title.toLowerCase()}.`} />
      
      {/* Hero Section */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 relative overflow-hidden pt-32 pb-20 px-6">
        {/* Abstract background elements */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-full overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
          <div className="absolute -top-[20%] -left-[10%] w-[50%] h-[50%] bg-primary/20 blur-[120px] rounded-full mix-blend-screen" />
          <div className="absolute top-[20%] -right-[10%] w-[40%] h-[40%] bg-secondary/20 blur-[120px] rounded-full mix-blend-screen" />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[url('/grid.svg')] opacity-20" />
        </div>

        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto relative z-10">
          {/* Breadcrumbs */}
          <nav className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-400 mb-8 font-medium">
            <Link to="/" className="hover:text-white transition-colors">Home</Link>
            <ChevronRight size={14} />
            <span className="text-white">{title}</span>
          </nav>
          
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
          >
            <button 
              onClick={() => navigate(-1)}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-primary hover:text-primary-light transition-colors mb-6 font-semibold"
            >
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back
            </button>
            <h1 className="text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black text-white tracking-tight mb-6">
              {title}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-lg md:text-xl text-slate-300 max-w-2xl font-medium leading-relaxed">
              Everything you need to know about our {title.toLowerCase()}. We value transparency and are committed to providing the best experience for our community of creators.
            </p>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Content Section */}
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-6 py-20">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.2 }}
          className="prose prose-lg prose-slate max-w-none"
        >
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-8 md:p-12 rounded-3xl border border-slate-100 mb-12">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-6">Overview</h2>
            <p className="text-slate-600 mb-6 leading-relaxed">
              Welcome to the {title} page of KDW Marketplace. This section is designed to give you comprehensive information regarding our policies, guidelines, and services. As a premium digital marketplace, we ensure that our creators and customers have a seamless, secure, and transparent experience.
            </p>
            <p className="text-slate-600 mb-6 leading-relaxed">
              If you have any specific questions that are not addressed here, our support team is available 24/7. We continuously update our documentation to reflect the latest industry standards and platform improvements.
            </p>

            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 mt-10 mb-4">Key Principles</h3>
            <ul className="space-y-4 mb-8">
              {[
                'Commitment to high-quality digital assets and tools.',
                'Transparent pricing and secure payment processing.',
                'Dedicated support for both creators and buyers.',
                'Continuous platform improvements and feature rollouts.'
              ].map((item, idx) => (
                <li key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-3 text-slate-600">
                  <div className="mt-1.5 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary flex-shrink-0" />
                  <span>{item}</span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>

            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 mt-10">
              <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 mb-2">Need further assistance?</h4>
              <p className="text-slate-500 mb-4 text-sm">Our support team is ready to help you with any questions regarding this topic.</p>
              <Link 
                to="/support"
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-2.5 bg-slate-900 text-white font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors shadow-sm"
              >
                Contact Support
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';

  const featuredProducts = products.slice(0, 3);
  const featuredBundles = bundles.filter(b => b.featured).slice(0, 3);
  // If no featured bundles explicitly marked, just show the latest one or two
  const bundlesToShow = featuredBundles.length > 0 ? featuredBundles : bundles.slice(0, 3);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-slate-50">

                  src={category.image || "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1498050108023-c5249f4df085?auto=format&fit=crop&q=80"}
                  alt={`Cover image for ${category.name}`} 
                  loading="lazy"
                  decoding="async"
                  className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover opacity-50 group-hover:opacity-70 transition-all duration-500 group-hover:scale-105" 
                /><div className="absolute inset-0 p-6 flex flex-col justify-end bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-100 via-slate-100/90 to-transparent">
                  <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-1 group-hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors">{category.name}</h3>
                  <p className="text-slate-600 text-sm mb-2">{category.description}</p>
                  <span className="inline-block px-3 py-1 bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full text-xs font-medium text-slate-900 w-max border border-slate-200">
                    {category.count} Products
                  </span>
                </div>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

      {/* Featured Products */}

        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-12">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900">Trending Now</h2>

          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
            {featuredProducts.map(product => (
              <ProductCard key={product.id} product={product} />

                <p className="text-slate-600">Save more when you buy curated collections</p>
              </div>
              <Link to="/bundles" className="text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                View All Bundles <ArrowRight size={16} />
              </Link>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
              {bundlesToShow.map(bundle => (
                <BundleCard key={bundle.id} bundle={bundle} />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/Login.tsx
```tsx
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Mail, Lock, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { z } from 'zod';
import Button from '../components/Button';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';

const loginSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string().email("Please enter a valid email address."),
  password: z.string().min(6, "Password must be at least 6 characters."),
});

type LoginFormValues = z.infer<typeof loginSchema>;

export default function Login() {
  const { register, handleSubmit, formState: { errors, isSubmitting } } = useForm<LoginFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(loginSchema)
  });
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { login } = useAuth();

  const onSubmit = async (data: LoginFormValues) => {
    try {
      const normalizedEmail = data.email.trim().toLowerCase();
      const response = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: normalizedEmail, password: data.password }),
      });

      let result;
      let rawText = '';
      try {
        rawText = await response.text();
        result = JSON.parse(rawText);
      } catch (parseError) {
        throw new Error(`Server returned an invalid response. Raw output: ${rawText.slice(0, 100)}...`);
      }

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(result.message || 'Failed to login');
      }

      login(result.token, {
        id: result.user.id,
        name: result.user.name,
        email: result.user.email,
        role: result.user.role
      });
      navigate('/dashboard');
    } catch (error: any) {
      alert(error.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-[80vh] flex items-center justify-center px-4 relative overflow-hidden">
      <SEO title="Log In" description="Sign in to your Kanishk Digital World account." />
      <div className="absolute top-1/4 -left-1/4 w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-primary/10 rounded-full blur-[100px] -z-10"></div>
      
      <div className="glass p-8 md:p-12 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md border border-slate-200 shadow-xl">
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 mb-2">Welcome Back</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-600">Log in to access your digital assets</p>
        </div>
        
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-5">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Email Address</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                <Mail size={18} className={errors.email ? "text-danger" : "text-slate-600"} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <input 
                id="email"
                type="email" 
                {...register("email")}
                className={`w-full bg-slate-50 border ${errors.email ? 'border-danger focus:ring-danger/50' : 'border-slate-200 focus:ring-primary/50'} rounded-xl py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-all`}
                placeholder="you@example.com"
                aria-invalid={errors.email ? "true" : "false"}
              />
            </div>
            {errors.email && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger flex items-center gap-1" role="alert">{errors.email.message}</p>}
          </div>
          
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
              <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Password</label>
              <Link to="/forgot-password" className="text-xs text-primary hover:text-accent transition-colors">Forgot password?</Link>
            </div>
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                <Lock size={18} className={errors.password ? "text-danger" : "text-slate-600"} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <input 
                id="password"
                type="password" 
                {...register("password")}
                className={`w-full bg-slate-50 border ${errors.password ? 'border-danger focus:ring-danger/50' : 'border-slate-200 focus:ring-primary/50'} rounded-xl py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-all`}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                aria-invalid={errors.password ? "true" : "false"}
              />
            </div>
            {errors.password && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger flex items-center gap-1" role="alert">{errors.password.message}</p>}
          </div>
          
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full mt-4" size="lg" isLoading={isSubmitting}>
            Sign In <ArrowRight size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
          </Button>
        </form>
        
        <div className="mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-slate-200 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">
            Don't have an account? <Link to="/register" className="text-slate-900 font-semibold hover:text-primary transition-colors focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:outline-none rounded">Sign up for free</Link>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/MyTickets.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Ticket, Clock, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, MessageSquare } from 'lucide-react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import Button from '../components/Button';

export default function MyTickets() {
  const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const { token } = useAuth();

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTickets = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await axios.get('/api/tickets', {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
        });
        if (res.data.success) {
          setTickets(res.data.data);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch tickets", err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    if (token) fetchTickets();
  }, [token]);

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    switch(status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'open':
        return <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 rounded-full text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1"><AlertCircle size={14} /> Open</span>;
      case 'pending':
        return <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 rounded-full text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1"><Clock size={14} /> Pending</span>;
      case 'resolved':
      case 'closed':
        return <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-success/10 text-success-dark rounded-full text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1"><CheckCircle2 size={14} /> {status}</span>;
      default:
        return <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded-full text-xs font-bold">{status}</span>;
    }
  };

  const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) => {
    switch(priority.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'urgent': return 'text-red-500';
      case 'high': return 'text-orange-500';
      case 'normal': return 'text-blue-500';
      case 'low': return 'text-slate-500';
      default: return 'text-slate-500';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 py-12 px-6">
      <SEO title="My Tickets | Support" description="View and manage your support tickets." />
      
      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4 mb-8">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight flex items-center gap-3">
              <Ticket className="text-primary" size={32} />
              My Support Tickets
            </h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 mt-2">Track the status of your inquiries and communicate with our support team.</p>
          </div>
          <Link to="/support/ticket">
            <Button>Raise New Ticket</Button>
          </Link>
        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500">Loading your tickets...</div>
        ) : tickets.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-12 text-center shadow-sm">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-slate-50 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
              <Ticket size={32} className="text-slate-400" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-2">No tickets yet</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-500 mb-8 max-w-sm mx-auto">You haven't submitted any support requests. If you need help, feel free to reach out!</p>
            <Link to="/support/ticket">
              <Button>Contact Support</Button>
            </Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100 text-slate-500 text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <th className="p-4 pl-6">Ticket ID</th>
                    <th className="p-4">Subject</th>
                    <th className="p-4">Status</th>
                    <th className="p-4">Priority</th>
                    <th className="p-4">Updated</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {tickets.map(ticket => (
                    <tr key={ticket.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors group cursor-pointer" onClick={() => window.location.href = `/support/my-tickets/${ticket.id}`}>
                      <td className="p-4 pl-6 font-mono text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">
                        {ticket.ticketNumber}
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-4">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">{ticket.subject}</div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1 mt-1">
                          <MessageSquare size={14} /> {ticket._count?.messages || 0} messages
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-4">
                        {getStatusBadge(ticket.status)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-4">
                        <span className={`text-sm font-bold capitalize ${getPriorityColor(ticket.priority)}`}>
                          {ticket.priority}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-4 text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium">
                        {new Date(ticket.updatedAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
