### front end/src/pages/OrderTracking.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import axios from 'axios';
import { Package, Truck, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import { formatCurrency } from '../utils/currency';

export default function OrderTracking() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const [order, setOrder] = useState<any>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // In a real app, fetch order by id. We use mock fetch here based on store/api if available
    const fetchOrder = async () => {
      try {
        // const res = await axios.get(`/api/orders/${id}`);
        // if(res.data.success) setOrder(res.data.data);
        
        // Mock data since /api/orders/:id might not be fully wired up yet for single fetches
        setTimeout(() => {
          setOrder({
            orderId: id || 'ORD-2026-1029',
            status: 'Shipped',
            totalAmount: 149.00,
            date: new Date().toISOString(),
            items: [
              { name: 'SaaS Framer Template', quantity: 1, price: 99.00, coverImage: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1460925895917-afdab827c52f?w=200' },
              { name: 'Dashboard UI Kit', quantity: 1, price: 50.00, coverImage: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1512758117929-08ce414d4858?w=200' }
            ],
            statusHistory: [
              { status: 'Ordered', timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 86400000 * 2).toISOString(), note: 'Order placed successfully' },
              { status: 'Packed', timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 86400000 * 1.5).toISOString(), note: 'Items packed and ready for shipping' },
              { status: 'Shipped', timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 86400000 * 1).toISOString(), note: 'Handed over to delivery partner' }
            ],
            trackingNumber: 'TRK9876543210'
          });
          setIsLoading(false);
        }, 500);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
      }
    };
    fetchOrder();
  }, [id]);

  if (isLoading) return <div className="min-h-screen py-12 flex items-center justify-center">Loading tracking details...</div>;
  if (!order) return <div className="min-h-screen py-12 flex items-center justify-center">Order not found</div>;

  const timelineSteps = ['Ordered', 'Packed', 'Shipped', 'Out for Delivery', 'Delivered'];
  const currentStepIndex = timelineSteps.indexOf(order.status);
  // Fallback if status is something like cancelled
  const isCancelled = order.status === 'Cancelled' || order.status === 'Refunded';

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen py-12 px-6 bg-slate-50">
      <SEO title={`Track Order ${order.orderId}`} description="Track your order status and timeline." />
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <Link to="/dashboard" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 mb-8 transition-colors">
          <ArrowLeft size={16} /> Back to Dashboard
        </Link>
        
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-8">
          <div className="flex-1 space-y-6">
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 pb-6 border-b border-slate-100">
                <div>
                  <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">Order {order.orderId}</h1>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">Placed on {new Date(order.date).toLocaleDateString()}</p>
                </div>
                {order.trackingNumber && (
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">Tracking Number</div>
                    <div className="font-mono text-primary font-bold">{order.trackingNumber}</div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {isCancelled ? (
                <div className="p-4 bg-danger/10 border border-danger/20 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-3">
                  <AlertCircle className="text-danger flex-shrink-0" />
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-danger">Order {order.status}</h3>
                    <p className="text-sm text-danger/80">This order has been {order.status.toLowerCase()}. Please contact support if you have questions.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="relative pt-8 pb-4 pl-4 sm:pl-0 sm:px-8">
                  <div className="absolute left-6 sm:left-8 top-12 bottom-12 w-0.5 bg-slate-100 sm:left-8 sm:right-8 sm:top-12 sm:w-auto sm:h-0.5 z-0 hidden sm:block"></div>
                  
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between gap-8 sm:gap-0 relative z-10">
                    {timelineSteps.map((step, idx) => {
                      const isCompleted = currentStepIndex >= idx;
                      const isCurrent = currentStepIndex === idx;
                      const historyItem = order.statusHistory?.find((h: any) => h.status === step);

                      let Icon = Package;
                      if (step === 'Shipped') Icon = Truck;
                      if (step === 'Delivered') Icon = CheckCircle2;

                      return (
                        <div key={step} className="flex sm:flex-col items-start sm:items-center relative">
                          <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold relative z-10 transition-colors ${
                            isCompleted ? 'bg-primary text-white shadow-lg shadow-primary/30' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-2 border-white'
                          }`}>
                            <Icon size={18} />
                          </div>
                          
                          {/* Mobile Connector Line */}
                          {idx !== timelineSteps.length - 1 && (
                            <div className={`absolute left-5 top-10 bottom-[-2rem] w-0.5 sm:hidden ${isCompleted && currentStepIndex > idx ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-slate-100'}`}></div>
                          )}

                          <div className="ml-4 sm:ml-0 sm:mt-4 sm:text-center">
                            <h4 className={`font-bold ${isCurrent ? 'text-primary' : isCompleted ? 'text-slate-900' : 'text-slate-600'}`}>
                              {step}
                            </h4>
                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 max-w-[120px]">
                              {historyItem ? new Date(historyItem.timestamp).toLocaleDateString() : 'Pending'}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-4">Detailed Updates</h2>
              <div className="space-y-6">
                {[...(order.statusHistory || [])].reverse().map((history: any, idx: number) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="flex gap-4">
                    <div className="w-12 text-right flex-shrink-0">
                      <div className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">{new Date(history.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit' })}</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">{new Date(history.timestamp).toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-px bg-slate-200 relative my-2">
                      <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3 h-3 rounded-full border-2 border-primary bg-white"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="py-1">
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-800">{history.status}</h4>
                      <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">{history.note}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="w-full md:w-80 flex-shrink-0">
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm sticky top-24">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 mb-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">Order Summary</h3>
              <div className="space-y-4 mb-6">
                {order.items.map((item: any, idx: number) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="flex gap-3">
                    <img src={item.coverImage} className="w-16 h-16 object-cover rounded-lg border border-slate-100" />
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-800 text-sm line-clamp-2">{item.name}</div>
                      <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">Qty: {item.quantity} × {formatCurrency(item.price)}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="border-t border-slate-100 pt-4 flex justify-between items-center">
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-700">Total</span>
                <span className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">{formatCurrency(order.totalAmount)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/Register.tsx
```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { User, Mail, Lock, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { z } from 'zod';
import Button from '../components/Button';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';

const registerSchema = z.object({
  fullName: z.string().min(2, "Name must be at least 2 characters."),
  email: z.string().email("Please enter a valid email address."),
  password: z.string().min(8, "Password must be at least 8 characters."),
});

type RegisterFormValues = z.infer<typeof registerSchema>;

export default function Register() {
  const { register, handleSubmit, formState: { errors, isSubmitting } } = useForm<RegisterFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(registerSchema)
  });
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { login } = useAuth();

  const onSubmit = async (data: RegisterFormValues) => {
    try {
      const normalizedEmail = data.email.trim().toLowerCase();
      const response = await fetch('/api/auth/register', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: data.fullName,
          email: normalizedEmail,
          password: data.password
        }),
      });

      let result;
      let rawText = '';
      try {
        rawText = await response.text();
        result = JSON.parse(rawText);
      } catch (parseError) {
        throw new Error(`Server returned an invalid response. Raw output: ${rawText.slice(0, 100)}...`);
      }

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(result.message || 'Failed to register');
      }

      // Auto login after successful registration
      login(result.data.token, {
        id: result.data._id,
        name: result.data.name,
        email: result.data.email,
        role: result.data.role
      });
      navigate('/dashboard');
      
    } catch (error: any) {
      alert(error.message); // Could be improved with toast
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-[80vh] flex items-center justify-center px-4 relative overflow-hidden my-12">
      <SEO title="Create Account" description="Join Kanishk Digital World to download premium assets." />
      <div className="absolute top-1/2 right-0 w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-accent/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] -z-10 translate-x-1/4"></div>
      
      <div className="glass p-8 md:p-12 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md border border-slate-200 shadow-xl">
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 mb-2">Create Account</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-600">Join KDW to download premium assets</p>
        </div>
        
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-5">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="fullName" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Full Name</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                <User size={18} className={errors.fullName ? "text-danger" : "text-slate-600"} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <input 
                id="fullName"
                type="text" 
                {...register("fullName")}
                className={`w-full bg-slate-50 border ${errors.fullName ? 'border-danger focus:ring-danger/50' : 'border-slate-200 focus:ring-accent/50'} rounded-xl py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-all`}
                placeholder="John Doe"
                aria-invalid={errors.fullName ? "true" : "false"}
              />
            </div>
            {errors.fullName && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger flex items-center gap-1" role="alert">{errors.fullName.message}</p>}
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Email Address</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                <Mail size={18} className={errors.email ? "text-danger" : "text-slate-600"} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <input 
                id="email"
                type="email" 
                {...register("email")}
                className={`w-full bg-slate-50 border ${errors.email ? 'border-danger focus:ring-danger/50' : 'border-slate-200 focus:ring-accent/50'} rounded-xl py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-all`}
                placeholder="you@example.com"
                aria-invalid={errors.email ? "true" : "false"}
              />
            </div>
            {errors.email && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger flex items-center gap-1" role="alert">{errors.email.message}</p>}
          </div>
          
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Password</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                <Lock size={18} className={errors.password ? "text-danger" : "text-slate-600"} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <input 
                id="password"
                type="password" 
                {...register("password")}
                className={`w-full bg-slate-50 border ${errors.password ? 'border-danger focus:ring-danger/50' : 'border-slate-200 focus:ring-accent/50'} rounded-xl py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-all`}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                aria-invalid={errors.password ? "true" : "false"}
              />
            </div>
            {errors.password && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger flex items-center gap-1" role="alert">{errors.password.message}</p>}
          </div>
          
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" className="w-full mt-4" size="lg" isLoading={isSubmitting}>
            Create Account <ArrowRight size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
          </Button>
        </form>
        
        <div className="mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-slate-200 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">
            Already have an account? <Link to="/login" className="text-slate-900 font-semibold hover:text-accent transition-colors focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent focus-visible:outline-none rounded">Log in</Link>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/ResetPassword.tsx
```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Lock, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { z } from 'zod';
import Button from '../components/Button';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';

const resetSchema = z.object({
  password: z.string().min(8, "Password must be at least 8 characters."),
  confirmPassword: z.string()
}).refine((data) => data.password === data.confirmPassword, {
  message: "Passwords do not match",
  path: ["confirmPassword"],
});

type ResetFormValues = z.infer<typeof resetSchema>;

export default function ResetPassword() {
  const { token } = useParams<{ token: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  
  const { register, handleSubmit, formState: { errors, isSubmitting } } = useForm<ResetFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(resetSchema)
  });
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState('');

  const onSubmit = async (data: ResetFormValues) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/auth/reset-password/${token}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ password: data.password }),
      });

      const result = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(result.message || 'Failed to reset password');
      }

      setSuccessMessage('Password has been successfully reset. You can now login with your new password.');
      setTimeout(() => {
        navigate('/login');
      }, 3000);
    } catch (error: any) {
      alert(error.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-[80vh] flex items-center justify-center px-4 relative overflow-hidden">
      <SEO title="Reset Password" description="Create a new password for your account." />
      <div className="absolute top-1/4 -left-1/4 w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-primary/10 rounded-full blur-[100px] -z-10"></div>
      
      <div className="glass p-8 md:p-12 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md border border-slate-200 shadow-xl">
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 mb-2">Reset Password</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-600">Enter your new secure password below</p>
        </div>
        
        {successMessage ? (
          <div className="text-center">
            <div className="p-4 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-xl text-green-700 mb-6">
              {successMessage}
            </div>
            <Link to="/login" className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 hover:text-primary transition-colors">
              <ArrowLeft size={16} /> Proceed to Login
            </Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-5">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">New Password</label>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                  <Lock size={18} className={errors.password ? "text-danger" : "text-slate-600"} aria-hidden="true" />
                </div>
                <input 
                  id="password"
                  type="password" 
                  {...register("password")}
                  className={`w-full bg-slate-50 border ${errors.password ? 'border-danger focus:ring-danger/50' : 'border-slate-200 focus:ring-primary/50'} rounded-xl py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-all`}
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  aria-invalid={errors.password ? "true" : "false"}
                />
              </div>
              {errors.password && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger flex items-center gap-1" role="alert">{errors.password.message}</p>}
            </div>
            
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="confirmPassword" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Confirm New Password</label>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                  <Lock size={18} className={errors.confirmPassword ? "text-danger" : "text-slate-600"} aria-hidden="true" />
                </div>
                <input 
                  id="confirmPassword"
                  type="password" 
                  {...register("confirmPassword")}
                  className={`w-full bg-slate-50 border ${errors.confirmPassword ? 'border-danger focus:ring-danger/50' : 'border-slate-200 focus:ring-primary/50'} rounded-xl py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-all`}
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  aria-invalid={errors.confirmPassword ? "true" : "false"}
                />
              </div>
              {errors.confirmPassword && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger flex items-center gap-1" role="alert">{errors.confirmPassword.message}</p>}
            </div>
            
            <Button type="submit" className="w-full mt-4" size="lg" isLoading={isSubmitting}>
              Reset Password <ArrowRight size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
            </Button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import axios from 'axios';
import ProductCard from '../components/ProductCard';
import { formatCurrency } from '../utils/currency';
import { Filter, SlidersHorizontal, ChevronDown, X, Loader2, Star } from 'lucide-react';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import { useStore } from '../store/useStore';
import FilterSidebar from '../components/shop/FilterSidebar';
import Skeleton from '../components/ui/Skeleton';

export default function Shop() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [isFilterOpen, setIsFilterOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  
  const storeProducts = useStore(state => state.products);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [totalProducts, setTotalProducts] = useState(0);
  
  const activeCategory = searchParams.get('category') || 'All';
  const searchQuery = searchParams.get('q') || '';
  const sort = searchParams.get('sort') || 'createdAt';
  const ratingFilter = searchParams.get('rating') || '';

  const categories = useStore(state => state.categories);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchProducts = async () => {
      setIsLoading(true);
      
      // Simulate slight network delay for skeleton loading
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
      
      try {
        let localProducts = [...storeProducts];
        
        if (activeCategory !== 'All') {
          localProducts = localProducts.filter(p => {
            const catName = typeof p.category === 'object' ? p.category?.name : p.category;
            return catName === activeCategory;
          });
        }
        if (searchQuery) {
          localProducts = localProducts.filter(p => {
            const title = p.title || (p as any).name || '';
            return title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
          });
        }
        if (ratingFilter) {
          localProducts = localProducts.filter(p => p.rating >= Number(ratingFilter));
        }
        
        // Sorting
        if (sort === 'price_asc') localProducts.sort((a,b) => a.price - b.price);
        if (sort === 'price_desc') localProducts.sort((a,b) => b.price - a.price);
        if (sort === 'rating') localProducts.sort((a,b) => (b.rating || 0) - (a.rating || 0));
        
        setProducts(localProducts);
        setTotalProducts(localProducts.length);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchProducts();
  }, [activeCategory, searchQuery, sort, ratingFilter, storeProducts]);

  const updateParams = (key: string, value: string) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
    if (!value || value === 'All') {
      params.delete(key);
    } else {
      params.set(key, value);
    }
    setSearchParams(params);
  };

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchParams(new URLSearchParams());
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen py-12 px-6 bg-slate-50/50">
      <SEO title="Shop" description="Browse our premium digital products, website kits, and templates." />
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-8 md:gap-12 relative">
        
        {/* Mobile Filter Toggle */}
        <div className="md:hidden flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">Products</h1>
          <button 
            onClick={() => setIsFilterOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-200/60 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900 shadow-sm focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:outline-none"
            aria-label="Open Filters"
          >
            <Filter size={16} /> Filters
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Sidebar Filters */}
        <FilterSidebar 
          isFilterOpen={isFilterOpen}
          setIsFilterOpen={setIsFilterOpen}
          categories={categories}
          activeCategory={activeCategory}
          ratingFilter={ratingFilter}
          updateParams={updateParams}
          clearFilters={clearFilters}
        />

        {/* Product Grid Area */}
        <main className="flex-1">
          <div className="hidden md:flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between mb-10 gap-4">
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight mb-2">
                {searchQuery ? `Results for "${searchQuery}"` : activeCategory === 'All' ? 'All Products' : activeCategory}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">{totalProducts} products available</p>
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="relative group">
                <select 
                  value={sort}
                  onChange={(e) => updateParams('sort', e.target.value)}
                  className="appearance-none flex items-center gap-2 pl-4 pr-10 py-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300 cursor-pointer outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary shadow-sm transition-all"
                >
                  <option value="createdAt">Newest Arrivals</option>
                  <option value="price_asc">Price: Low to High</option>
                  <option value="price_desc">Price: High to Low</option>
                  <option value="popularity">Popularity</option>
                  <option value="rating">Top Rated</option>
                </select>
                <SlidersHorizontal size={14} className="absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-600 pointer-events-none" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8">
              {[...Array(6)].map((_, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                  <Skeleton className="w-full aspect-[4/3] rounded-2xl" />
                  <Skeleton className="h-6 w-3/4 rounded-lg" />
                  <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full rounded-lg" />
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-end mt-2">
                    <div>
                      <Skeleton className="h-4 w-16 mb-2 rounded-md" />
                      <Skeleton className="h-6 w-20 rounded-lg" />
                    </div>
                    <Skeleton className="h-10 w-10 rounded-xl" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : products.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8">
              {products.map((product, idx) => (
                <div key={product.id} className="animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 fill-mode-both" style={{ animationDelay: `${idx * 100}ms`, animationDuration: '500ms' }}>
                  <ProductCard product={product} />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl h-[400px] rounded-3xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-8 border border-slate-200/60 shadow-sm">
              <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-6 text-slate-600 rotate-12">
                <Filter size={32} />
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2 tracking-tight">No products found</h3>
              <p className="text-slate-500 mb-8 max-w-md">We couldn't find anything matching your current filters. Try adjusting your category or price range.</p>
              <button 
                onClick={clearFilters}
                className="px-8 py-3 bg-primary text-white text-sm font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-primary/90 transition-all shadow-md hover:shadow-primary/25 hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0"
              >
                Clear All Filters
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/pages/SubmitTicket.tsx
```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Send, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';

export default function SubmitTicket() {
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitted, setIsSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const { isAuthenticated, token } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  // Form state
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    subject: '',
    categoryId: '',
    priority: 'normal',
    message: ''
  });

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isAuthenticated || !token) {
      toast.error('You must be logged in to submit a ticket.');
      navigate('/login?redirect=/support/ticket');
      return;
    }
    
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    
    try {
      // Find category ID or pass as null for now if categories aren't loaded in dropdown
      const res = await axios.post('/api/tickets', formData, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      
      if (res.data.success) {
        setIsSubmitted(true);
        toast.success('Support ticket submitted successfully!');
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Failed to submit ticket', error);
      toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to submit ticket. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (isSubmitted) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 py-20 px-6 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="bg-white p-10 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-lg text-center max-w-md w-full">
          <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-success/10 text-success rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
            <CheckCircle2 size={40} />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-4">Ticket Received!</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-600 mb-8">
            Thank you for reaching out. Your support ticket has been received and our team will get back to you within 24 hours via email.
          </p>
          <Link to="/" className="inline-block w-full py-3 bg-slate-900 text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors">
            Return Home
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 py-12 px-6">
      <SEO title="Submit a Ticket | KDW Marketplace" description="Contact our support team for help with your products." />
      
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto pt-8">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight mb-4">Raise a Ticket</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-600">
            Having trouble with a product, billing, or your account? Fill out the form below and we'll help you sort it out.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-8 md:p-10 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 p-4 rounded-xl mb-8 border border-blue-100">
            <AlertCircle size={20} className="shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-blue-600" />
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">
              Before submitting a ticket, please check our <Link to="/docs" className="underline hover:text-blue-900">Knowledge Base</Link> or <Link to="/faq" className="underline hover:text-blue-900">FAQs</Link>. The answer you're looking for might already be there!
            </p>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">Category / Topic</label>
              <select 
                value={formData.categoryId}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({...formData, categoryId: e.target.value})}
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:bg-white transition-all appearance-none cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="">Select a topic...</option>
                <option value="technical">Technical Support</option>
                <option value="billing">Billing & Refunds</option>
                <option value="account">Account Issues</option>
                <option value="presales">Pre-sales Questions</option>
                <option value="other">Other</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">Priority</label>
                <select 
                  value={formData.priority}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({...formData, priority: e.target.value})}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:bg-white transition-all appearance-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="low">Low</option>
                  <option value="normal">Normal</option>
                  <option value="high">High</option>
                  <option value="urgent">Urgent</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">Subject</label>
                <input 
                  required 
                  type="text" 
                  value={formData.subject}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({...formData, subject: e.target.value})}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:bg-white transition-all" 
                  placeholder="Brief summary of the issue" 
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">Description</label>
              <textarea 
                required 
                rows={6} 
                value={formData.message}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({...formData, message: e.target.value})}
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:bg-white transition-all resize-none" 
                placeholder="Please describe your issue in detail. Include any relevant URLs, error messages, or steps to reproduce."
              ></textarea>
            </div>



            <button 
              type="submit" 
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="w-full bg-primary hover:bg-primary-dark text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all disabled:opacity-70 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Send size={18} /> Submit Ticket
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

```tsx
import { LifeBuoy, MessageSquare, FileText, ChevronRight, CreditCard, Download, ShieldCheck, Ticket } from 'lucide-react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import SmartSearch from '../components/support/SmartSearch';
import { useStore } from '../store/useStore';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export default function Support() {
  const { supportCategories, supportArticles } = useStore();
  const [popularArticles, setPopularArticles] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [recentArticles, setRecentArticles] = useState<any[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Sort articles for display
    if (supportArticles.length > 0) {
      setPopularArticles([...supportArticles].sort((a, b) => b.views - a.views).slice(0, 4));
      setRecentArticles([...supportArticles].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime()).slice(0, 4));
    }
  }, [supportArticles]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50">
      {/* Hero Section */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 pt-24 pb-32 px-6 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
          <div className="absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-96 h-96 bg-primary/20 blur-3xl rounded-full"></div>
          <div className="absolute top-1/2 -left-24 w-72 h-72 bg-accent/20 blur-3xl rounded-full"></div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto text-center relative z-10">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md text-white border border-white/20 text-sm font-bold tracking-wide mb-8">
            <LifeBuoy size={16} className="text-primary" />
            <span>Support Center</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-5xl md:text-7xl font-black text-white tracking-tight mb-8">
            How can we help you today?
          </h1>
          <SmartSearch />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 -mt-16 relative z-20 pb-24 space-y-16">
        
        {/* Quick Access Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] border border-slate-100 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all group flex flex-col h-full">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-primary/10 text-primary rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
              <FileText size={28} />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-3">Knowledge Base</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-600 mb-6 flex-1 text-lg">Browse our comprehensive guides and tutorials to get the most out of our products.</p>
            <Link to="/docs" className="text-primary font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2 group-hover:gap-3 transition-all">Read Articles <ChevronRight size={20} /></Link>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] border border-slate-100 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all group flex flex-col h-full">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-accent/10 text-accent rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
              <MessageSquare size={28} />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-3">Raise a Ticket</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-600 mb-6 flex-1 text-lg">Can't find what you're looking for? Submit a ticket and our team will get back to you.</p>
            <Link to="/support/ticket" className="text-accent font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2 group-hover:gap-3 transition-all">Contact Support <ChevronRight size={20} /></Link>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] border border-slate-100 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all group flex flex-col h-full">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-success/10 text-success rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
              <Ticket size={28} />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-3">My Tickets</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-600 mb-6 flex-1 text-lg">View the status of your existing support requests and reply to open tickets.</p>
            <Link to="/support/my-tickets" className="text-success font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2 group-hover:gap-3 transition-all">View Tickets <ChevronRight size={20} /></Link>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Popular Categories */}
        {supportCategories.length > 0 && (
          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-8">
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900">Browse by Topic</h2>
              <Link to="/docs" className="text-primary font-bold hover:underline">View all topics</Link>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              {supportCategories.map((category) => (
                <Link

                     <FileText size={24} />}
                  </div>
                  <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">{category.name}</h4>
                  <span className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">{category._count?.articles || 0} Articles</span>
                </Link>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Articles Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12">
          {/* Popular Articles */}
          {popularArticles.length > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">

                <span className="text-xl">🔥</span> Popular Articles
              </h2>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {popularArticles.map(article => (
                  <Link 
                    key={article.id} 
                    to={`/docs/${article.slug}`}
                    className="block group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-4 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-primary transition-colors text-lg mb-1">{article.title}</h4>
                        <div className="flex gap-4 text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium">
                          <span>{article.category?.name}</span>
                          <span>{article.views} views</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ChevronRight className="text-slate-300 group-hover:text-primary transition-colors" />
                    </div>
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Recently Updated */}
          {recentArticles.length > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-6 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xl">✨</span> Recently Updated
              </h2>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {recentArticles.map(article => (
                  <Link 
                    key={article.id} 
                    to={`/docs/${article.slug}`}
                    className="block group"
                  >
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-4 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-accent transition-colors text-lg mb-1">{article.title}</h4>
                        <div className="flex gap-4 text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium">
                          <span>{article.category?.name}</span>
                          <span>Updated {new Date(article.updatedAt).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ChevronRight className="text-slate-300 group-hover:text-accent transition-colors" />
                    </div>
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Heart, ShoppingCart, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useStore } from '../store/useStore';
import Button from '../components/Button';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import { formatCurrency } from '../utils/currency';

export default function Wishlist() {
  const { wishlist, toggleWishlist, addToCart } = useStore();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen py-12 px-6 bg-slate-50">
      <SEO title="Your Wishlist | Kanishk Digital World" description="View and manage your saved premium templates and kits." />
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8 flex-wrap gap-4">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-3">
            <Heart size={32} className="text-primary fill-primary" />
            Your Wishlist
          </h1>
          {wishlist.length > 0 && (
            <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">{wishlist.length} saved items</span>
          )}
        </div>

        {wishlist.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-12 text-center border border-slate-200 shadow-sm max-w-2xl mx-auto">
            <div className="w-24 h-24 bg-slate-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
              <Heart size={40} className="text-slate-700" />
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-4">Your wishlist is empty</h2>
            <p className="text-slate-600 mb-8">
              Keep track of the products you love. Click the heart icon on any product to save it here for later.
            </p>
            <Button onClick={() => navigate('/shop')} size="lg">
              Explore Products
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
            {wishlist.map((item) => (
              <div key={item.id} className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow overflow-hidden group flex flex-col h-full">
                <Link to={`/product/${item.id}`} className="relative aspect-video overflow-hidden">
                  <img src={item.coverImage} alt={item.title} className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105" />
                  <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 px-2 py-1 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-900 shadow-sm">
                    {typeof item.category === 'object' ? (item.category as any).name : item.category}
                  </div>
                </Link>
                <div className="p-5 flex flex-col flex-1">
                  <Link to={`/product/${item.id}`} className="flex-1">
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 line-clamp-2 hover:text-primary transition-colors">{item.title}</h3>
                  </Link>
                  <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900">{formatCurrency(item.price)}</span>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <button 
                        onClick={() => toggleWishlist(item)}
                        className="p-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-danger hover:bg-danger/10 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                        aria-label="Remove from wishlist"
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={18} />
                      </button>
                      <button 
                        onClick={() => {
                          addToCart(item);
                          toggleWishlist(item); // Optional: remove from wishlist when adding to cart
                        }}
                        className="w-10 h-10 bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-white rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-colors shadow-sm focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:outline-none"
                        aria-label="Add to cart"
                      >
                        <ShoppingCart size={18} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### front end/src/store/useStore.ts
```ts
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';
import axios from 'axios';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface StoreState {
  cart: any[];
  wishlist: any[];
  products: any[];
  categories: any[];
  bundles: any[];
  orders: any[];
  supportCategories: any[];
  supportArticles: any[];
  isCartOpen: boolean;
  isWishlistOpen: boolean;
  addToCart: (product: any) => void;
  removeFromCart: (productId: string) => void;
  toggleWishlist: (product: any) => void;
  setCartOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  setWishlistOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  clearCart: () => void;
  addProduct: (product: any) => void;
  updateProduct: (productId: string, updatedData: any) => void;
  removeProduct: (productId: string) => void;
  setProducts: (products: any[]) => void;
  fetchProducts: () => Promise<void>;
  fetchCategories: () => Promise<void>;
  fetchBundles: () => Promise<void>;
  fetchSupportCategories: () => Promise<void>;
  fetchSupportArticles: () => Promise<void>;
  addCategory: (category: any) => void;
  removeCategory: (categoryId: string) => void;
  addOrder: (order: any) => void;
  razorpayAccounts: any[];
  addRazorpayAccount: (account: any) => void;
  setRazorpayAccountDefault: (accountId: string) => void;
  toggleRazorpayAccountActive: (accountId: string) => void;
}

export const useStore = create<StoreState>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      cart: [],
      wishlist: [],
      products: [],
      categories: [],
      bundles: [],
      orders: [],
      supportCategories: [],
      supportArticles: [],
      isCartOpen: false,
      isWishlistOpen: false,
      
      addToCart: (product) => set((state) => {
        if (state.cart.find(item => item.id === product.id)) return state;
        return { cart: [...state.cart, product], isCartOpen: true };
      }),
      
      removeFromCart: (productId) => set((state) => ({
        cart: state.cart.filter(item => item.id !== productId)
      })),
      
      toggleWishlist: (product) => set((state) => {
        const exists = state.wishlist.find(item => item.id === product.id);
        if (exists) {
          return { wishlist: state.wishlist.filter(item => item.id !== product.id) };
        }
        return { wishlist: [...state.wishlist, product], isWishlistOpen: true };
      }),
      
      setCartOpen: (isOpen) => set({ isCartOpen: isOpen }),
      setWishlistOpen: (isOpen) => set({ isWishlistOpen: isOpen }),
      clearCart: () => set({ cart: [] }),

      addProduct: (product) => set((state) => ({
        products: [product, ...state.products]
      })),
      updateProduct: (productId, updatedData) => set((state) => ({
        products: state.products.map(p => p.id === productId ? { ...p, ...updatedData } : p)
      })),
      removeProduct: (productId) => set((state) => ({
        products: state.products.filter(p => p.id !== productId)
      })),
      setProducts: (products) => set({ products }),
      fetchProducts: async () => {
        try {
          const response = await axios.get('/api/products?limit=1000&_t=' + Date.now());
          if (response.data.success) {
            const mappedProducts = response.data.data.map((p: any) => {
              let tagsArray = [];
              if (Array.isArray(p.tags)) {
                tagsArray = p.tags;
              } else if (typeof p.tags === 'string') {
                try {
                  tagsArray = JSON.parse(p.tags);
                } catch (e) {
                  tagsArray = p.tags.split(',').map((t: string) => t.trim());
                }
              }
              let badge = '';
              if (p.bestSeller) badge = 'Best Seller';
              else if (p.featured) badge = 'Featured';
              
              return {
                ...p,
                id: p._id || p.id,
                title: p.name,
                description: p.description,
                price: p.price,
                category: (typeof p.category === 'object' ? (p.category as any).name : p.category) || 'Uncategorized',
                coverImage: p.coverImage || p.thumbnail || undefined,
                status: p.status || 'ACTIVE',
                sales: p._count?.purchases || 0,
                rating: 4.8, // Fallback for UI
                reviews: Math.floor(Math.random() * 500) + 100, // Fallback for UI
                isBestSeller: p.bestSeller || false,
                isFeatured: p.featured || false,
                tags: tagsArray,
                badge: badge
              };
            });
            set({ products: mappedProducts });
          } else {
            toast.error("Failed to load products.");
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Error fetching products:", error);
          toast.error("Error fetching products. Please check your connection.");
        }
      },
      fetchCategories: async () => {
        try {
          const response = await axios.get('/api/categories?_t=' + Date.now());
          if (response.data.success) {
            const mappedCategories = response.data.data.map((c: any) => ({
              ...c,
              id: c._id || c.id,
              image: c.coverImage || c.image || undefined
            }));
            set({ categories: mappedCategories });
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Error fetching categories:", error);
        }
      },
      fetchBundles: async () => {
        try {
          const response = await axios.get('/api/bundles?_t=' + Date.now());
          if (response.data.success) {
            set({ bundles: response.data.data });
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Error fetching bundles:", error);
        }
      },
      fetchSupportCategories: async () => {
        try {
          const res = await axios.get('/api/support/categories');
          if (res.data.success) {
            set({ supportCategories: res.data.data });
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Error fetching support categories:", error);
        }
      },
      fetchSupportArticles: async () => {
        try {
          const res = await axios.get('/api/support/articles');
          if (res.data.success) {
            set({ supportArticles: res.data.data });
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Error fetching support articles:", error);
        }
      },
      addCategory: (category) => set((state) => ({
        categories: [category, ...state.categories]
      })),
      removeCategory: (categoryId) => set((state) => ({
        categories: state.categories.filter(c => c.id !== categoryId)
      })),
      addOrder: (order) => set((state) => ({
        orders: [order, ...state.orders]
      })),
      razorpayAccounts: [
        {
          id: 'acc_1',
          accountId: 'acc_Gj98KjlM34vX',
          name: 'Main Business Account',
          bankName: 'HDFC Bank (**** 4512)',
          isDefault: true,
          isActive: true
        }
      ],
      addRazorpayAccount: (account) => set((state) => ({
        razorpayAccounts: [...state.razorpayAccounts, { ...account, id: `acc_${Date.now()}` }]
      })),
      setRazorpayAccountDefault: (id) => set((state) => ({
        razorpayAccounts: state.razorpayAccounts.map(acc => ({
          ...acc,
          isDefault: acc.id === id
        }))
      })),
      toggleRazorpayAccountActive: (id) => set((state) => ({
        razorpayAccounts: state.razorpayAccounts.map(acc => {
          if (acc.id === id) {
            return { ...acc, isActive: !acc.isActive };
          }
          return acc;
        })
      }))
    }),
    {
      name: 'kdw-store-v5',
      partialize: (state) => ({ 
        cart: state.cart, 
        wishlist: state.wishlist, 
        orders: state.orders,
        razorpayAccounts: state.razorpayAccounts
      }), 
    }
  )
);
```

```ts
import axios from 'axios';

// The base URL depends on how Vite proxies the requests
const API_URL = '/api/reviews';

export const getPublicReviews = async (productId: string, params: any) => {
  const response = await axios.get(`${API_URL}/product/${productId}`, { params });
  return response.data;
};

export const submitReview = async (reviewData: any) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  const response = await axios.post(API_URL, reviewData, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });
  return response.data;
};

export const editReview = async (id: string, reviewData: any) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  const response = await axios.put(`${API_URL}/${id}`, reviewData, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });
  return response.data;
};

export const voteReview = async (id: string, voteType: 'helpful' | 'notHelpful') => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  const response = await axios.post(`${API_URL}/${id}/vote`, { voteType }, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });
  return response.data;
};

export const reportReview = async (id: string, reason: string, details?: string) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  const response = await axios.post(`${API_URL}/${id}/report`, { reason, details }, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });
  return response.data;
};

// Admin Endpoints
export const getAdminReviews = async () => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  const response = await axios.get(API_URL, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });
  return response.data;
};

export const updateReviewStatus = async (id: string, status: string) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  const response = await axios.put(`${API_URL}/${id}/status`, { status }, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });
  return response.data;
};

export const creatorReply = async (id: string, text: string) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  const response = await axios.post(`${API_URL}/${id}/reply`, { text }, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });
  return response.data;
};
```

### front end/src/utils/csvExport.ts
```ts
export const exportToCSV = (data: any[], filename: string) => {
  if (data.length === 0) {
    alert("No data available to export");
    return;
  }

  // Get headers from first object
  const headers = Object.keys(data[0]);
  
  // Create CSV string
  const csvRows = [];
  
  // Add headers
  csvRows.push(headers.join(','));
  
  // Add data rows
  for (const row of data) {
    const values = headers.map(header => {
      const val = row[header];
      // Escape strings containing commas or quotes
      if (typeof val === 'string') {
        const escaped = val.replace(/"/g, '""');
        return `"${escaped}"`;
      }
      return val !== null && val !== undefined ? val : '';
    });
    csvRows.push(values.join(','));
  }
  
  const csvContent = csvRows.join('\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  if (link.download !== undefined) {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.setAttribute('href', url);
    link.setAttribute('download', `${filename}.csv`);
    link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  }
};
```

```ts
export const formatCurrency = (amount: number): string => {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "INR",
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(amount || 0);
```

### replace_urls.js
```js
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

function replaceInFiles(dir) {
  const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
  
  for (const file of files) {
    const fullPath = path.join(dir, file);
    if (fs.statSync(fullPath).isDirectory()) {
      replaceInFiles(fullPath);
    } else if (fullPath.endsWith('.ts') || fullPath.endsWith('.tsx')) {
      let content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
      if (content.includes('http://localhost:5000/api')) {
        content = content.replace(/http:\/\/localhost:5000\/api/g, '/api');
        fs.writeFileSync(fullPath, content, 'utf8');
        console.log(`Updated ${fullPath}`);
      }
    }
  }
}

replaceInFiles(path.join(__dirname, 'front end', 'src'));
console.log('Replacement complete.');
```

### server/fix_bundle_prices.js
```js
const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client');
const prisma = new PrismaClient();
async function run() {
  const bundles = await prisma.bundle.findMany({ include: { products: true } });
  for (const b of bundles) {
    const sum = b.products.reduce((acc, p) => acc + (p.price || 0), 0);
    if (sum > 0) {
      const newPrice = Math.floor(sum * 0.7);
      await prisma.bundle.update({
        where: { id: b.id },
        data: { originalPrice: sum, price: newPrice }
      });
      console.log('Updated', b.title, 'sum:', sum, 'price:', newPrice);
    }
  }
}
run().catch(console.error).finally(() => prisma.$disconnect());

```

### server/prisma/schema.prisma
```prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  name          String
  email         String   @unique
  mobile        String?
  passwordHash  String
  emailVerified Boolean  @default(false)
  role          String   @default("CUSTOMER")
  profileImage  String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  orders    Order[]
  purchases Purchase[]
}

model Category {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  name         String
  slug         String   @unique
  description  String?
  image        String?
  banner       String?
  displayOrder Int      @default(0)
  status       String   @default("ACTIVE")
  featured     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  products Product[]
}

model Product {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  categoryId        String
  name              String
  slug              String   @unique
  description       String
  shortDescription  String?
  price             Float
  discountPrice     Float?
  googleDriveFileId String?
  thumbnail         String?
  previewImages     String?
  version           String?
  features          String?
  fileSize          String?
  tags              String?
  status            String   @default("ACTIVE")
  featured          Boolean  @default(false)
  bestSeller        Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt

  category   Category    @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id])
  orderItems OrderItem[]
  purchases  Purchase[]
  reviews    Review[]
  bundles    Bundle[]
}

model Order {
  id                String        @id @default(uuid())
  orderNumber       String        @unique
  customerId        String?
  guestName         String?
  guestEmail        String?
  guestMobile       String?
  totalAmount       Float
  currency          String        @default("INR")
  paymentStatus     String        @default("PENDING")
  orderStatus       String        @default("PENDING")
  razorpayOrderId   String?
  razorpayPaymentId String?
  razorpaySignature String?
  createdAt         DateTime      @default(now())
  paidAt            DateTime?

  customer User?       @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id])
  items    OrderItem[]
}

model OrderItem {
  id          String @id @default(uuid())
  orderId     String
  productId   String?
  bundleId    String?
  productName String
  quantity    Int
  unitPrice   Float

  order   Order    @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product? @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
  bundle  Bundle?  @relation(fields: [bundleId], references: [id])
}

model Purchase {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  customerId    String
  productId     String
  accessStatus  String   @default("ACTIVE")
  downloadCount Int      @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  customer     User          @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id])
  product      Product       @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
  accessTokens AccessToken[]
}

model AccessToken {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  purchaseId  String
  secureToken String    @unique
  expiresAt   DateTime
  lastUsedAt  DateTime?

  purchase Purchase @relation(fields: [purchaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model HeroBanner {
  id         String  @id @default(uuid())
  title      String
  subtitle   String?
  image      String
  buttonText String?
  buttonUrl  String?
  status     String  @default("ACTIVE")
  sortOrder  Int     @default(0)
}

model Testimonial {
  id           String  @id @default(uuid())
  customerName String
  company      String?
  designation  String?
  image        String?
  review       String
  rating       Int     @default(5)
  status       String  @default("ACTIVE")
}

model FAQ {
  id        String @id @default(uuid())
  question  String
  answer    String
  sortOrder Int    @default(0)
  status    String @default("ACTIVE")
}

model Blog {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  title         String
  slug          String   @unique
  coverImage    String
  content       String
  author        String
  publishedDate DateTime @default(now())
  status        String   @default("ACTIVE")
}

model Coupon {
  id            String    @id @default(uuid())
  code          String    @unique
  discountType  String // "PERCENTAGE" or "FIXED"
  discountValue Float
  expiryDate    DateTime?
  usageLimit    Int?
  usedCount     Int       @default(0)
  status        String    @default("ACTIVE")
}

model SiteSettings {
  id            String  @id @default("DEFAULT")
  companyName   String
  logo          String?
  favicon       String?
  supportEmail  String?
  phone         String?
  whatsapp      String?
  socialLinks   String?
  footerContent String?
  seoSettings   String?
}

model Bundle {
  id            String    @id @default(uuid())
  title         String
  slug          String    @unique
  description   String
  price         Float
  originalPrice Float
  discount      Float     @default(0)
  coverImage    String
  rating        Float     @default(5.0)
  itemsIncluded Int       @default(0)
  status        String    @default("ACTIVE")
  featured      Boolean   @default(false)
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt

  products      Product[]
  orderItems    OrderItem[]
}

model Review {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  productId    String
  customerName String
  rating       Int      @default(5)
  title        String
  comment      String
  status       String   @default("PENDING") // PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED
  images       String?  // JSON serialized string array
  videos       String?  // JSON serialized string array
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

```

### server/scratch/check_users.js
```js
const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client');
const prisma = new PrismaClient();

async function main() {
  const users = await prisma.user.findMany();
  console.log('Users in DB:');
  users.forEach(u => console.log(`- ${u.email} (ID: ${u.id})`));
}

main()
  .catch(e => console.error(e))
  .finally(async () => {
```

```js
const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client');
```

```js
async function seedBundle() {
  try {
    const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: {
        name: {
          in: [
            'Ultimate ChatGPT Prompt Library',
            'AI Business Prompt Collection',
            'Reels Creator Pack'
          ]
        }
      }
    });

    if (products.length !== 3) {
      console.warn('Could not find all 3 products. Found:', products.map(p => p.name));
    }

    const bundle = await prisma.bundle.create({
      data: {
        title: 'Creator AI Mastery Bundle',
        description: 'Everything creators need to generate ideas with AI, create high-converting content, and grow on Instagram using premium templates and prompt collections.',
        price: 2526.0,
        originalPrice: 2597.0,
        coverImage: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1620641788421-7a1c342ea42e?w=800&q=80',
        rating: 4.9,
        itemsIncluded: products.length,
        products: {
          connect: products.map(p => ({ id: p.id }))
        }
      },
      include: {
        products: true
      }
    });

    console.log('Successfully created bundle:', bundle.title);
    console.log('Included products:', bundle.products.map(p => p.name));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to seed bundle:', error);
  } finally {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  }
}

seedBundle();
```

```js
  { "title": "Instagram Growth Bundle", "slug": "instagram-growth-bundle", "description": "Premium collection of editable Instagram templates to increase engagement and brand visibility.", "price": 999, "category": "Instagram Bundles", "coverImage": "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1611162617474-5b21e879e113?auto=format&fit=crop&q=80&w=800", "tags": ["Instagram", "Growth", "Templates"] },

];

async function seed() {
  console.log('Seeding original mock data...');

  // 1. Delete all existing products and categories to avoid duplicates
  await prisma.product.deleteMany({});
  await prisma.category.deleteMany({});
  
  // 2. Insert Categories
  const categoryMap = {};
  for (const cat of categories) {
    const createdCat = await prisma.category.create({
      data: {
        name: cat.name,
        slug: cat.slug,
        description: cat.description,
        image: cat.image,
        displayOrder: cat.displayOrder,
        status: 'ACTIVE'
      }
    });
    categoryMap[cat.name] = createdCat.id;
  }
  console.log(`Inserted ${categories.length} categories.`);

  // 3. Insert Products
  for (const prod of products) {
    const categoryId = categoryMap[prod.category];
    if (!categoryId) {
      console.warn(`Category ${prod.category} not found for product ${prod.title}`);
      continue;
    }

    await prisma.product.create({
      data: {
        categoryId,
        name: prod.title,
        slug: prod.slug,
        description: prod.description,
        price: prod.price,
        thumbnail: prod.coverImage,
        tags: JSON.stringify(prod.tags),
        bestSeller: prod.isBestSeller || false,
        featured: prod.isFeatured || false,
        status: 'ACTIVE'
      }
    });
  }
  console.log(`Inserted ${products.length} products.`);
  
  console.log('Seeding complete!');
}

seed()
  .catch(e => {
    console.error(e);
    process.exit(1);
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });
```

### server/src/app.ts
```ts
import express from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import helmet from 'helmet';
import morgan from 'morgan';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import path from 'path';

const app = express();

// Middleware
app.use(express.json({ limit: '50mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '50mb' }));
app.use(cookieParser());
app.use(cors({
  origin: function (origin, callback) {
    if (!origin || origin.startsWith('http://localhost:')) {
      callback(null, true);
    } else {
      callback(new Error('Not allowed by CORS'));
    }
  },
  credentials: true
}));
app.use(helmet());
app.use(morgan('dev'));

// Routes
import authRoutes from './routes/authRoutes';
import productRoutes from './routes/productRoutes';
import categoryRoutes from './routes/categoryRoutes';
import paymentRoutes from './routes/paymentRoutes';
import analyticsRoutes from './routes/analyticsRoutes';
import adminRoutes from './routes/adminRoutes';
import bundleRoutes from './routes/bundleRoutes';
import reviewRoutes from './routes/reviewRoutes';
import purchaseRoutes from './routes/purchaseRoutes';

app.use('/api/auth', authRoutes);
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/categories', categoryRoutes);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin/analytics', analyticsRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', adminRoutes);
app.use('/api/bundles', bundleRoutes);
app.use('/api/reviews', reviewRoutes);
app.use('/api/purchases', purchaseRoutes);

// Basic health check route
app.get('/api/health', (req, res) => {
  res.status(200).json({ status: 'ok', message: 'KDW Backend is running' });
});

// Serve static frontend in production
const frontendDistPath = path.join(__dirname, '../../front end/dist');
app.use(express.static(frontendDistPath));

app.use((req: express.Request, res: express.Response, next: express.NextFunction) => {
  if (req.method === 'GET' && !req.originalUrl.startsWith('/api')) {
    return res.sendFile(path.join(frontendDistPath, 'index.html'));
  }
  next();
});



// Error handling middleware
app.use((err: any, req: express.Request, res: express.Response, next: express.NextFunction) => {
  console.error(err.stack);
  res.status(err.status || 500).json({
    success: false,
    message: err.message || 'Internal Server Error'
  });
});

export default app;
```

```ts
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import os from 'os';

export const getSystemHealth = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const totalMem = os.totalmem();
    const freeMem = os.freemem();
    const usedMem = totalMem - freeMem;
    const memoryUsagePercent = ((usedMem / totalMem) * 100).toFixed(2);
    
    // Format bytes to GB
    const formatMem = (bytes: number) => (bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2) + ' GB';

    // Format uptime
    const formatUptime = (seconds: number) => {
      const d = Math.floor(seconds / (3600*24));
      const h = Math.floor(seconds % (3600*24) / 3600);
      const m = Math.floor(seconds % 3600 / 60);
      return `${d}d ${h}h ${m}m`;
    };

    res.status(200).json({
      data: {
        status: 'Healthy',
        database: {
          status: 'Connected',
          host: 'SQLite (dev.db)'
        },
        server: {
          memory: {
            usagePercent: `${memoryUsagePercent}%`,
            used: formatMem(usedMem),
            total: formatMem(totalMem)
          },
          cpu: {
            cores: os.cpus().length,
            model: os.cpus()[0]?.model || 'Unknown CPU'
          },
          uptime: {
            system: formatUptime(os.uptime()),
            process: formatUptime(process.uptime())
          }
        }
      }
    });
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(500).json({ message: 'Error fetching system health' });
  }
};
```
